88 static inline bool is_printer(QPainter *p)
89 {
90  if (!p || !p->device())
91  return false;
92  return p->device()->devType() == QInternal::Printer;
93 }
94 
95 static inline int scale(int value, QPainter *painter)
96 {
97  if (is_printer(painter)) {
98  Q3PaintDeviceMetrics metrics(painter->device());
99 #if defined(Q_WS_X11)
100  value = value * metrics.logicalDpiY() /
101  QX11Info::appDpiY(painter->device()->x11Screen());
102 #elif defined (Q_WS_WIN)
103  HDC hdc = GetDC(0);
104  int gdc = GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSY);
105  if (gdc)
106  value = value * metrics.logicalDpiY() / gdc;
107  ReleaseDC(0, hdc);
108 #elif defined (Q_WS_MAC)
109  value = value * metrics.logicalDpiY() / 75; // ##### FIXME
110 #elif defined (Q_WS_QWS)
111  value = value * metrics.logicalDpiY() / 75;
112 #endif
113  }
114  return value;
115 }

118 static inline bool isBreakable(Q3TextString *string, int pos)
119 {
120  if (string->at(pos).nobreak)
121  return false;
122  return (pos < string->length()-1 && string->at(pos+1).softBreak);
123 }

127 void Q3TextCommandHistory::addCommand(Q3TextCommand *cmd)
128 {
129  if (current < history.count() - 1) {
130  QList<Q3TextCommand *> commands;
131 
132  for (int i = 0; i <= current; ++i)
133  commands.insert(i, history.takeFirst());
134 
135  commands.append(cmd);
136  while (!history.isEmpty())
137  delete history.takeFirst();
138  history = commands;
139  } else {
140  history.append(cmd);
141  }
142 
143  if (history.count() > steps)
144  delete history.takeFirst();
145  else
146  ++current;
147 }

149 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextCommandHistory::undo(Q3TextCursor *c)
150 {
151  if (current > -1) {
152  Q3TextCursor *c2 = history.at(current)->unexecute(c);
153  --current;
154  return c2;
155  }
156  return 0;
157 }
158 
159 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextCommandHistory::redo(Q3TextCursor *c)
160 {
161  if (current > -1) {
162  if (current < history.count() - 1) {
163  ++current;
164  return history.at(current)->execute(c);
165  }
166  } else {
167  if (history.count() > 0) {
168  ++current;
169  return history.at(current)->execute(c);
170  }
171  }
172  return 0;
173 }

175 bool Q3TextCommandHistory::isUndoAvailable()
176 {
177  return current > -1;

180 bool Q3TextCommandHistory::isRedoAvailable()
181 {
182  return (current > -1 && current < history.count() - 1) || (current == -1 && history.count() > 0);

215 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextDeleteCommand::execute(Q3TextCursor *c)
216 {
217  Q3TextParagraph *s = doc ? doc->paragAt(id) : parag;
218  if (!s) {
219  qWarning("can't locate parag at %d, last parag: %d", id, doc->lastParagraph()->paragId());
220  return 0;
221  }
222 
223  cursor.setParagraph(s);
224  cursor.setIndex(index);
225  int len = text.size();
226  if (c)
227  *c = cursor;
228  if (doc) {
229  doc->setSelectionStart(Q3TextDocument::Temp, cursor);
230  for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i)
231  cursor.gotoNextLetter();
232  doc->setSelectionEnd(Q3TextDocument::Temp, cursor);
233  doc->removeSelectedText(Q3TextDocument::Temp, &cursor);
234  if (c)
235  *c = cursor;
236  } else {
237  s->remove(index, len);
238  }
239 
240  return c;
241 }
242 
243 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextDeleteCommand::unexecute(Q3TextCursor *c)
244 {
245  Q3TextParagraph *s = doc ? doc->paragAt(id) : parag;
246  if (!s) {
247  qWarning("can't locate parag at %d, last parag: %d", id, doc->lastParagraph()->paragId());
248  return 0;
249  }
250 
251  cursor.setParagraph(s);
252  cursor.setIndex(index);
253  QString str = Q3TextString::toString(text);
254  cursor.insert(str, true, &text);
255  if (c)
256  *c = cursor;
257  cursor.setParagraph(s);
258  cursor.setIndex(index);
259 
260 #ifndef QT_NO_DATASTREAM
261  if (!styleInformation.isEmpty()) {
262  QDataStream styleStream(&styleInformation, IO_ReadOnly);
263  int num;
264  styleStream >> num;
265  Q3TextParagraph *p = s;
266  while (num-- && p) {
267  p->readStyleInformation(styleStream);
268  p = p->next();
269  }
270  }
271 #endif
272  s = cursor.paragraph();
273  while (s) {
274  s->format();
275  s->setChanged(true);
276  if (s == c->paragraph())
277  break;
278  s = s->next();
279  }
280 
281  return &cursor;
282 }

284 Q3TextFormatCommand::Q3TextFormatCommand(Q3TextDocument *dc, int sid, int sidx, int eid, int eidx,
285  const QVector<Q3TextStringChar> &old, Q3TextFormat *f, int fl)
286  : Q3TextCommand(dc), startId(sid), startIndex(sidx), endId(eid), endIndex(eidx), format(f), oldFormats(old), flags(fl)
287 {
288  format = dc->formatCollection()->format(f);
289  for (int j = 0; j < (int)oldFormats.size(); ++j) {
290  if (oldFormats[j].format())
291  oldFormats[j].format()->addRef();
292  }
293 }
294 
295 Q3TextFormatCommand::~Q3TextFormatCommand()
296 {
297  format->removeRef();
298  for (int j = 0; j < (int)oldFormats.size(); ++j) {
299  if (oldFormats[j].format())
300  oldFormats[j].format()->removeRef();
301  }
302 }
303 
304 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextFormatCommand::execute(Q3TextCursor *c)
305 {
306  Q3TextParagraph *sp = doc->paragAt(startId);
307  Q3TextParagraph *ep = doc->paragAt(endId);
308  if (!sp || !ep)
309  return c;
310 
311  Q3TextCursor start(doc);
312  start.setParagraph(sp);
313  start.setIndex(startIndex);
314  Q3TextCursor end(doc);
315  end.setParagraph(ep);
316  end.setIndex(endIndex);
317 
318  doc->setSelectionStart(Q3TextDocument::Temp, start);
319  doc->setSelectionEnd(Q3TextDocument::Temp, end);
320  doc->setFormat(Q3TextDocument::Temp, format, flags);
321  doc->removeSelection(Q3TextDocument::Temp);
322  if (endIndex == ep->length())
323  end.gotoLeft();
324  *c = end;
325  return c;
326 }
327 
328 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextFormatCommand::unexecute(Q3TextCursor *c)
329 {
330  Q3TextParagraph *sp = doc->paragAt(startId);
331  Q3TextParagraph *ep = doc->paragAt(endId);
332  if (!sp || !ep)
333  return 0;
334 
335  int idx = startIndex;
336  int fIndex = 0;
337  while ( fIndex < int(oldFormats.size()) ) {
338  if (oldFormats.at(fIndex).c == QLatin1Char('\n')) {
339  if (idx > 0) {
340  if (idx < sp->length() && fIndex > 0)
341  sp->setFormat(idx, 1, oldFormats.at(fIndex - 1).format());
342  if (sp == ep)
343  break;
344  sp = sp->next();
345  idx = 0;
346  }
347  fIndex++;
348  }
349  if (oldFormats.at(fIndex).format())
350  sp->setFormat(idx, 1, oldFormats.at(fIndex).format());
351  idx++;
352  fIndex++;
353  if (fIndex >= (int)oldFormats.size())
354  break;
355  if (idx >= sp->length()) {
356  if (sp == ep)
357  break;
358  sp = sp->next();
359  idx = 0;
360  }
361  }
362 
363  Q3TextCursor end(doc);
364  end.setParagraph(ep);
365  end.setIndex(endIndex);
366  if (endIndex == ep->length())
367  end.gotoLeft();
368  *c = end;
369  return c;
370 }

372 Q3TextStyleCommand::Q3TextStyleCommand(Q3TextDocument *dc, int fParag, int lParag, const QByteArray& beforeChange)
373  : Q3TextCommand(dc), firstParag(fParag), lastParag(lParag), before(beforeChange)

379 QByteArray Q3TextStyleCommand::readStyleInformation( Q3TextDocument* doc, int fParag, int lParag)
380 {
381  QByteArray style;
382 #ifndef QT_NO_DATASTREAM
383  Q3TextParagraph *p = doc->paragAt(fParag);
384  if (!p)
385  return style;
386  QDataStream styleStream(&style, IO_WriteOnly);
387  int num = lParag - fParag + 1;
388  styleStream << num;
389  while (num -- && p) {
390  p->writeStyleInformation(styleStream);
391  p = p->next();
392  }
393 #endif
394  return style;
395 }
396 
397 void Q3TextStyleCommand::writeStyleInformation( Q3TextDocument* doc, int fParag, const QByteArray& style)
398 {
399 #ifndef QT_NO_DATASTREAM
400  Q3TextParagraph *p = doc->paragAt(fParag);
401  if (!p)
402  return;
403  QByteArray copy = style;
404  QDataStream styleStream(&copy, IO_ReadOnly);
405  int num;
406  styleStream >> num;
407  while (num-- && p) {
408  p->readStyleInformation(styleStream);
409  p = p->next();
410  }
411 #endif
412 }
413 
414 Q3TextCursor *Q3TextStyleCommand::execute(Q3TextCursor *c)
415 {

421 {

423  return c;

490 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
491 void Q3TextCursor::gotoIntoNested(const QPoint &globalPos)
492 {
493  if (!para)
494  return;
495  Q_ASSERT(para->at(idx)->isCustom());
496  push();
497  ox = 0;
498  int bl, y;
499  para->lineHeightOfChar(idx, &bl, &y);
500  oy = y + para->rect().y();
501  ox = para->at(idx)->x;
502  Q3TextDocument* doc = document();
503  para->at(idx)->customItem()->enterAt(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy, globalPos-QPoint(ox,oy));
504 }
505 #endif
506 
507 void Q3TextCursor::invalidateNested()
508 {
509  if (nestedDepth()) {
510  QStack<Q3TextParagraph*>::Iterator it = paras.begin();
511  QStack<int>::Iterator it2 = indices.begin();
512  for (; it != paras.end(); ++it, ++it2) {
513  if (*it == para)
514  continue;
515  (*it)->invalidate(0);
516 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
517  if ((*it)->at(*it2)->isCustom())
518  (*it)->at(*it2)->customItem()->invalidate();
519 #endif
520  }
521  }
522 }

524 void Q3TextCursor::insert(const QString &str, bool checkNewLine, QVector<Q3TextStringChar> *formatting)
525 {
526  tmpX = -1;
527  bool justInsert = true;
528  QString s(str);
529 #if defined(Q_WS_WIN)
530  if (checkNewLine) {
531  int i = 0;
532  while ((i = s.indexOf(QLatin1Char('\r'), i)) != -1)
533  s.remove(i ,1);
534  }
535 #endif
536  if (checkNewLine)
537  justInsert = s.indexOf(QLatin1Char('\n')) == -1;
538  if (justInsert) { // we ignore new lines and insert all in the current para at the current index
539  para->insert(idx, s.unicode(), s.length());
540  if (formatting) {
541  for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); ++i) {
542  if (formatting->at(i).format()) {
543  formatting->at(i).format()->addRef();
544  para->string()->setFormat(idx + i, formatting->at(i).format(), true);
545  }
546  }
547  }
548  idx += s.length();
549  } else { // we split at new lines
550  int start = -1;
551  int end;
552  int y = para->rect().y() + para->rect().height();
553  int lastIndex = 0;
554  do {
555  end = s.indexOf(QLatin1Char('\n'), start + 1); // find line break
556  if (end == -1) // didn't find one, so end of line is end of string
557  end = s.length();
558  int len = (start == -1 ? end : end - start - 1);
559  if (len > 0) // insert the line
560  para->insert(idx, s.unicode() + start + 1, len);
561  else
562  para->invalidate(0);
563  if (formatting) { // set formats to the chars of the line
564  for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
565  if (formatting->at(i + lastIndex).format()) {
566  formatting->at(i + lastIndex).format()->addRef();
567  para->string()->setFormat(i + idx, formatting->at(i + lastIndex).format(), true);
568  }
569  }
570  lastIndex += len;
571  }
572  start = end; // next start is at the end of this line
573  idx += len; // increase the index of the cursor to the end of the inserted text
574  if (s[end] == QLatin1Char('\n')) { // if at the end was a line break, break the line
575  splitAndInsertEmptyParagraph(false, true);
576  para->setEndState(-1);
577  para->prev()->format(-1, false);
578  lastIndex++;
579  }
580 
581  } while (end < (int)s.length());
582 
583  para->format(-1, false);
584  int dy = para->rect().y() + para->rect().height() - y;
585  Q3TextParagraph *p = para;
586  p->setParagId(p->prev() ? p->prev()->paragId() + 1 : 0);
587  p = p->next();
588  while (p) {
589  p->setParagId(p->prev()->paragId() + 1);
590  p->move(dy);
591  p->invalidate(0);
592  p->setEndState(-1);
593  p = p->next();
594  }
595  }
596 
597  int h = para->rect().height();
598  para->format(-1, true);
599  if (h != para->rect().height())
600  invalidateNested();
601  else if (para->document() && para->document()->parent())
602  para->document()->nextDoubleBuffered = true;
603 
604  fixCursorPosition();
605 }
606 
607 void Q3TextCursor::gotoLeft()
608 {
609  if (para->string()->isRightToLeft())
610  gotoNextLetter();
611  else
612  gotoPreviousLetter();
613 }
614 
615 void Q3TextCursor::gotoPreviousLetter()
616 {
617  tmpX = -1;
618 
619  if (idx > 0) {
620  idx = para->string()->previousCursorPosition(idx);
621 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
622  const Q3TextStringChar *tsc = para->at(idx);
623  if (tsc && tsc->isCustom() && tsc->customItem()->isNested())
624  processNesting(EnterEnd);
625 #endif
626  } else if (para->prev()) {
627  para = para->prev();
628  while (!para->isVisible() && para->prev())
629  para = para->prev();
630  idx = para->length() - 1;
631  } else if (nestedDepth()) {
632  pop();
633  processNesting(Prev);
634  if (idx == -1) {
635  pop();
636  if (idx > 0) {
637  idx = para->string()->previousCursorPosition(idx);
638 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
639  const Q3TextStringChar *tsc = para->at(idx);
640  if (tsc && tsc->isCustom() && tsc->customItem()->isNested())
641  processNesting(EnterEnd);
642 #endif
643  } else if (para->prev()) {
644  para = para->prev();
645  idx = para->length() - 1;
646  }
647  }
648  }
649 }

651 void Q3TextCursor::push()
652 {
653  indices.push(idx);
654  paras.push(para);
655  xOffsets.push(ox);
656  yOffsets.push(oy);

659 void Q3TextCursor::pop()
660 {
661  if (indices.isEmpty())
662  return;
663  idx = indices.pop();
664  para = paras.pop();
665  ox = xOffsets.pop();
666  oy = yOffsets.pop();
667 }

669 void Q3TextCursor::restoreState()
670 {
671  while (!indices.isEmpty())
672  pop();
673 }

675 bool Q3TextCursor::place(const QPoint &p, Q3TextParagraph *s, bool link)
676 {
677  QPoint pos(p);
678  QRect r;
679  Q3TextParagraph *str = s;
680  if (pos.y() < s->rect().y()) {
681  pos.setY(s->rect().y());
682 #ifdef Q_WS_MAC
683  pos.setX(s->rect().x());
684 #endif
685  }
686  while (s) {
687  r = s->rect();
688  r.setWidth(document() ? document()->width() : QWIDGETSIZE_MAX);
689  if (s->isVisible())
690  str = s;
691  if (pos.y() >= r.y() && pos.y() <= r.y() + r.height())
692  break;
693  if (!s->next()) {
694 #ifdef Q_WS_MAC
695  pos.setX(s->rect().x() + s->rect().width());
696 #endif
697  break;
698  }
699  s = s->next();
700  }
701 
702  if (!s || !str)
703  return false;
704 
705  s = str;
706 
707  setParagraph(s);
708  int y = s->rect().y();
709  int lines = s->lines();
710  Q3TextStringChar *chr = 0;
711  int index = 0;
712  int i = 0;
713  int cy = 0;
714  int ch = 0;
715  for (; i < lines; ++i) {
716  chr = s->lineStartOfLine(i, &index);
717  cy = s->lineY(i);
718  ch = s->lineHeight(i);
719  if (!chr)
720  return false;
721  if (pos.y() <= y + cy + ch)
722  break;
723  }
724  int nextLine;
725  if (i < lines - 1)
726  s->lineStartOfLine(i+1, &nextLine);
727  else
728  nextLine = s->length();
729  i = index;
730  int x = s->rect().x();
731  if (pos.x() < x)
732  pos.setX(x + 1);
733  int cw;
734  int curpos = s->length()-1;
735  int dist = 10000000;
736  bool inCustom = false;
737  while (i < nextLine) {
738  chr = s->at(i);
739  int cpos = x + chr->x;
740  cw = s->string()->width(i);
741 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
742  if (chr->isCustom() && chr->customItem()->isNested()) {
743  if (pos.x() >= cpos && pos.x() <= cpos + cw &&
744  pos.y() >= y + cy && pos.y() <= y + cy + chr->height()) {
745  inCustom = true;
746  curpos = i;
747  break;
748  }
749  } else
750 #endif
751  {
752  if(chr->rightToLeft)
753  cpos += cw;
754  int diff = cpos - pos.x();
755  bool dm = diff < 0 ? !chr->rightToLeft : chr->rightToLeft;
756  if ((QABS(diff) < dist || (dist == diff && dm == true)) && para->string()->validCursorPosition(i)) {
757  dist = QABS(diff);
758  if (!link || pos.x() >= x + chr->x)
759  curpos = i;
760  }
761  }
762  i++;
763  }
764  setIndex(curpos);
765 
766 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
767  if (inCustom && para->document() && para->at(curpos)->isCustom() && para->at(curpos)->customItem()->isNested()) {
768  Q3TextDocument *oldDoc = para->document();
769  gotoIntoNested(pos);
770  if (oldDoc == para->document())
771  return true;
772  QPoint p(pos.x() - offsetX(), pos.y() - offsetY());
773  if (!place(p, document()->firstParagraph(), link))
774  pop();
775  }
776 #endif
777  return true;
778 }
779 
780 bool Q3TextCursor::processNesting(Operation op)
781 {
782  if (!para->document())
783  return false;
784  Q3TextDocument* doc = para->document();
785  push();
786  ox = para->at(idx)->x;
787  int bl, y;
788  para->lineHeightOfChar(idx, &bl, &y);
789  oy = y + para->rect().y();
790  bool ok = false;
791 
792 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
793  switch (op) {
794  case EnterBegin:
795  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->enter(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy);
796  break;
797  case EnterEnd:
798  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->enter(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy, true);
799  break;
800  case Next:
801  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->next(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy);
802  break;
803  case Prev:
804  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->prev(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy);
805  break;
806  case Down:
807  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->down(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy);
808  break;
809  case Up:
810  ok = para->at(idx)->customItem()->up(this, doc, para, idx, ox, oy);
811  break;
812  }
813  if (!ok)
814 #endif
815  pop();
816  return ok;
817 }

819 void Q3TextCursor::gotoRight()
820 {

822  gotoPreviousLetter();
823  else
824  gotoNextLetter();

827 void Q3TextCursor::gotoNextLetter()
828 {
829  tmpX = -1;
830 
831 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
832  const Q3TextStringChar *tsc = para->at(idx);
833  if (tsc && tsc->isCustom() && tsc->customItem()->isNested()) {
834  if (processNesting(EnterBegin))
835  return;
836  }
837 #endif
838 
839  if (idx < para->length() - 1) {
840  idx = para->string()->nextCursorPosition(idx);
841  } else if (para->next()) {
842  para = para->next();
843  while (!para->isVisible() && para->next())
844  para = para->next();
845  idx = 0;
846  } else if (nestedDepth()) {
847  pop();
848  processNesting(Next);
849  if (idx == -1) {
850  pop();
851  if (idx < para->length() - 1) {
852  idx = para->string()->nextCursorPosition(idx);
853  } else if (para->next()) {
854  para = para->next();
855  idx = 0;
856  }
857  }
858  }
859 }

861 void Q3TextCursor::gotoUp()
862 {
863  int indexOfLineStart;
864  int line;
865  Q3TextStringChar *c = para->lineStartOfChar(idx, &indexOfLineStart, &line);
866  if (!c)
867  return;
868 
869  if (tmpX < 0)
870  tmpX = x();
871 
872  if (indexOfLineStart == 0) {
873  if (!para->prev()) {
874  if (!nestedDepth())
875  return;
876  pop();
877  processNesting(Up);
878  if (idx == -1) {
879  pop();
880  if (!para->prev())
881  return;
882  idx = tmpX = 0;
883  } else {
884  tmpX = -1;
885  return;
886  }
887  }
888  Q3TextParagraph *p = para->prev();
889  while (p && !p->isVisible())
890  p = p->prev();
891  if (p)
892  para = p;
893  int lastLine = para->lines() - 1;
894  if (!para->lineStartOfLine(lastLine, &indexOfLineStart))
895  return;
896  idx = indexOfLineStart;
897  while (idx < para->length()-1 && para->at(idx)->x < tmpX)
898  ++idx;
899  if (idx > indexOfLineStart &&
900  para->at(idx)->x - tmpX > tmpX - para->at(idx-1)->x)
901  --idx;
902  } else {
903  --line;
904  int oldIndexOfLineStart = indexOfLineStart;
905  if (!para->lineStartOfLine(line, &indexOfLineStart))
906  return;
907  idx = indexOfLineStart;
908  while (idx < oldIndexOfLineStart-1 && para->at(idx)->x < tmpX)
909  ++idx;
910  if (idx > indexOfLineStart &&
911  para->at(idx)->x - tmpX > tmpX - para->at(idx-1)->x)
912  --idx;
913  }
914  fixCursorPosition();
915 }
916 
917 void Q3TextCursor::gotoDown()
918 {
919  int indexOfLineStart;
920  int line;
921  Q3TextStringChar *c = para->lineStartOfChar(idx, &indexOfLineStart, &line);
922  if (!c)
923  return;
924 
925  if (tmpX < 0)
926  tmpX = x();
927 
928  if (line == para->lines() - 1) {
929  if (!para->next()) {
930  if (!nestedDepth())
931  return;
932  pop();
933  processNesting(Down);
934  if (idx == -1) {
935  pop();
936  if (!para->next())
937  return;
938  idx = tmpX = 0;
939  } else {
940  tmpX = -1;
941  return;
942  }
943  }
944  Q3TextParagraph *s = para->next();
945  while (s && !s->isVisible())
946  s = s->next();
947  if (s)
948  para = s;
949  if (!para->lineStartOfLine(0, &indexOfLineStart))
950  return;
951  int end;
952  if (para->lines() == 1)
953  end = para->length();
954  else
955  para->lineStartOfLine(1, &end);
956 
957  idx = indexOfLineStart;
958  while (idx < end-1 && para->at(idx)->x < tmpX)
959  ++idx;
960  if (idx > indexOfLineStart &&
961  para->at(idx)->x - tmpX > tmpX - para->at(idx-1)->x)
962  --idx;
963  } else {
964  ++line;
965  int end;
966  if (line == para->lines() - 1)
967  end = para->length();
968  else
969  para->lineStartOfLine(line + 1, &end);
970  if (!para->lineStartOfLine(line, &indexOfLineStart))
971  return;
972  idx = indexOfLineStart;
973  while (idx < end-1 && para->at(idx)->x < tmpX)
974  ++idx;
975  if (idx > indexOfLineStart &&
976  para->at(idx)->x - tmpX > tmpX - para->at(idx-1)->x)
977  --idx;
978  }
979  fixCursorPosition();
980 }

982 void Q3TextCursor::gotoLineEnd()

991  if (line == para->lines() - 1) {
992  idx = para->length() - 1;
993  } else {
994  c = para->lineStartOfLine(++line, &indexOfLineStart);
995  indexOfLineStart--;
996  idx = indexOfLineStart;
997  }

1065 static bool is_seperator(const QChar &c, bool onlySpace)
1066 {
1067  if (onlySpace)
1068  return c.isSpace();
1069  return c.isSpace() ||
1070  c == QLatin1Char('\t') ||
1071  c == QLatin1Char('.') ||
1072  c == QLatin1Char(',') ||
1073  c == QLatin1Char(':') ||
1074  c == QLatin1Char(';') ||
1075  c == QLatin1Char('-') ||
1076  c == QLatin1Char('<') ||
1077  c == QLatin1Char('>') ||
1078  c == QLatin1Char('[') ||
1079  c == QLatin1Char(']') ||
1080  c == QLatin1Char('(') ||
1081  c == QLatin1Char(')') ||
1082  c == QLatin1Char('{') ||
1083  c == QLatin1Char('}');
1084 }
1085 
1086 void Q3TextCursor::gotoPreviousWord(bool onlySpace)
1087 {
1088  gotoPreviousLetter();
1089  tmpX = -1;
1090  Q3TextString *s = para->string();
1091  bool allowSame = false;
1092  if (idx == ((int)s->length()-1))
1093  return;
1094  for (int i = idx; i >= 0; --i) {
1095  if (is_seperator(s->at(i).c, onlySpace)) {
1096  if (!allowSame)
1097  continue;
1098  idx = i + 1;
1099  return;
1100  }
1101  if (!allowSame && !is_seperator(s->at(i).c, onlySpace))
1102  allowSame = true;
1103  }
1104  idx = 0;
1105 }
1106 
1107 void Q3TextCursor::gotoNextWord(bool onlySpace)
1108 {
1109  tmpX = -1;
1110  Q3TextString *s = para->string();
1111  bool allowSame = false;
1112  for (int i = idx; i < (int)s->length(); ++i) {
1113  if (!is_seperator(s->at(i).c, onlySpace)) {
1114  if (!allowSame)
1115  continue;
1116  idx = i;
1117  return;
1118  }
1119  if (!allowSame && is_seperator(s->at(i).c, onlySpace))
1120  allowSame = true;
1121 
1122  }
1123 
1124  if (idx < ((int)s->length()-1)) {
1125  gotoLineEnd();
1126  } else if (para->next()) {
1127  Q3TextParagraph *p = para->next();
1128  while (p && !p->isVisible())
1129  p = p->next();
1130  if (s) {
1131  para = p;
1132  idx = 0;
1133  }
1134  } else {
1135  gotoLineEnd();
1136  }
1137 }

1149 void Q3TextCursor::splitAndInsertEmptyParagraph(bool ind, bool updateIds)
1150 {
1151  if (!para->document())
1152  return;
1153  tmpX = -1;
1154  Q3TextFormat *f = 0;
1155  if (para->document()->useFormatCollection()) {
1156  f = para->at(idx)->format();
1157  if (idx == para->length() - 1 && idx > 0)
1158  f = para->at(idx - 1)->format();
1159  if (f->isMisspelled()) {
1160  f->removeRef();
1161  f = para->document()->formatCollection()->format(f->font(), f->color());
1162  }
1163  }
1164 
1165  if (atParagEnd()) {
1166  Q3TextParagraph *n = para->next();
1167  Q3TextParagraph *s = para->document()->createParagraph(para->document(), para, n, updateIds);
1168  if (f)
1169  s->setFormat(0, 1, f, true);
1170  s->copyParagData(para);
1171  if (ind) {
1172  int oi, ni;
1173  s->indent(&oi, &ni);
1174  para = s;
1175  idx = ni;
1176  } else {
1177  para = s;
1178  idx = 0;
1179  }
1180  } else if (atParagStart()) {
1181  Q3TextParagraph *p = para->prev();
1182  Q3TextParagraph *s = para->document()->createParagraph(para->document(), p, para, updateIds);
1183  if (f)
1184  s->setFormat(0, 1, f, true);
1185  s->copyParagData(para);
1186  if (ind) {
1187  s->indent();
1188  s->format();
1189  indent();
1190  para->format();
1191  }
1192  } else {
1193  QString str = para->string()->toString().mid(idx, 0xFFFFFF);
1194  Q3TextParagraph *n = para->next();
1195  Q3TextParagraph *s = para->document()->createParagraph(para->document(), para, n, updateIds);
1196  s->copyParagData(para);
1197  s->remove(0, 1);
1198  s->append(str, true);
1199  for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); ++i) {
1200  Q3TextStringChar* tsc = para->at(idx + i);
1201  s->setFormat(i, 1, tsc->format(), true);
1202 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1203  if (tsc->isCustom()) {
1204  Q3TextCustomItem * item = tsc->customItem();
1205  s->at(i)->setCustomItem(item);
1206  tsc->loseCustomItem();
1207  }
1208 #endif
1209  if (tsc->isAnchor())
1210  s->at(i)->setAnchor(tsc->anchorName(),
1211  tsc->anchorHref());
1212  }
1213  para->truncate(idx);
1214  if (ind) {
1215  int oi, ni;
1216  s->indent(&oi, &ni);
1217  para = s;
1218  idx = ni;
1219  } else {
1220  para = s;
1221  idx = 0;
1222  }
1223  }
1224 
1225  invalidateNested();
1226 }

1228 bool Q3TextCursor::remove()
1229 {
1230  tmpX = -1;
1231  if (!atParagEnd()) {
1232  int next = para->string()->nextCursorPosition(idx);
1233  para->remove(idx, next-idx);
1234  int h = para->rect().height();
1235  para->format(-1, true);
1236  if (h != para->rect().height())
1237  invalidateNested();
1238  else if (para->document() && para->document()->parent())
1239  para->document()->nextDoubleBuffered = true;
1240  return false;
1241  } else if (para->next()) {
1242  para->join(para->next());
1243  invalidateNested();
1244  return true;
1245  }
1246  return false;
1247 }

1249 /* needed to implement backspace the correct way */
1250 bool Q3TextCursor::removePreviousChar()
1251 {
1252  tmpX = -1;
1253  if (!atParagStart()) {
1254  para->remove(idx-1, 1);
1255  int h = para->rect().height();
1256  idx--;
1257  // shouldn't be needed, just to make sure.
1258  fixCursorPosition();
1259  para->format(-1, true);
1260  if (h != para->rect().height())
1261  invalidateNested();
1262  else if (para->document() && para->document()->parent())
1263  para->document()->nextDoubleBuffered = true;
1264  return false;
1265  } else if (para->prev()) {
1266  para = para->prev();
1267  para->join(para->next());
1268  invalidateNested();
1269  return true;
1270  }
1271  return false;
1272 }

1280 
1281  if (idx >= oi)

1283  else
1284  idx = ni;

1287 void Q3TextCursor::fixCursorPosition()
1288 {
1289  // searches for the closest valid cursor position
1290  if (para->string()->validCursorPosition(idx))
1291  return;
1292 
1293  int lineIdx;
1294  Q3TextStringChar *start = para->lineStartOfChar(idx, &lineIdx, 0);
1295  int x = para->string()->at(idx).x;
1296  int diff = QABS(start->x - x);
1297  int best = lineIdx;
1298 
1299  Q3TextStringChar *c = start;
1300  ++c;
1301 
1302  Q3TextStringChar *end = &para->string()->at(para->length()-1);
1303  while (c <= end && !c->lineStart) {
1304  int xp = c->x;
1305  if (c->rightToLeft)
1306  xp += para->string()->width(lineIdx + (c-start));
1307  int ndiff = QABS(xp - x);
1308  if (ndiff < diff && para->string()->validCursorPosition(lineIdx + (c-start))) {
1309  diff = ndiff;
1310  best = lineIdx + (c-start);
1311  }
1312  ++c;
1313  }
1314  idx = best;
1315 }

1426 int Q3TextDocument::height() const
1427 {

1429  if (lParag)
1430  h = lParag->rect().top() + lParag->rect().height() + 1;
1431  int fh = flow_->boundingRect().bottom();
1432  return qMax(h, fh);
1433 }

1442 bool Q3TextDocument::setMinimumWidth(int needed, int used, Q3TextParagraph *p)
1443 {
1444  if (needed == -1) {
1445  minw = 0;
1446  wused = 0;
1447  p = 0;
1448  }
1449  if (p == minwParag) {
1450  if (minw > needed) {
1451  Q3TextParagraph *tp = fParag;
1452  while (tp) {
1453  if (tp != p && tp->minwidth > needed) {
1454  needed = tp->minwidth;
1455  minwParag = tp;
1456  }
1457  tp = tp->n;
1458  }
1459  }
1460  minw = needed;
1461  emit minimumWidthChanged(minw);
1462  } else if (needed > minw) {
1463  minw = needed;
1464  minwParag = p;
1465  emit minimumWidthChanged(minw);
1466  }
1467  wused = qMax(wused, used);
1468  wused = qMax(wused, minw);
1469  cw = qMax(minw, cw);
1470  return true;
1471 }

1473 void Q3TextDocument::setPlainText(const QString &text)
1474 {
1475  preferRichText = false;
1476  clear();
1477  oTextValid = true;
1478  oText = text;
1479 
1480  int lastNl = 0;
1481  int nl = text.indexOf(QLatin1Char('\n'));
1482  if (nl == -1) {
1483  lParag = createParagraph(this, lParag, 0);
1484  if (!fParag)
1485  fParag = lParag;
1486  QString s = text;
1487  if (!s.isEmpty()) {
1488  if (s[(int)s.length() - 1] == QLatin1Char('\r'))
1489  s.remove(s.length() - 1, 1);
1490  lParag->append(s);
1491  }
1492  } else {
1493  for (;;) {
1494  lParag = createParagraph(this, lParag, 0);
1495  if (!fParag)
1496  fParag = lParag;
1497  int l = nl - lastNl;
1498  if (l > 0) {
1499  if (text.unicode()[nl-1] == QLatin1Char('\r'))
1500  l--;
1501  QString cs = QString::fromRawData(text.unicode()+lastNl, l);
1502  lParag->append(cs);
1503  }
1504  if (nl == (int)text.length())
1505  break;
1506  lastNl = nl + 1;
1507  nl = text.indexOf(QLatin1Char('\n'), nl + 1);
1508  if (nl == -1)
1509  nl = text.length();
1510  }
1511  }
1512  if (!lParag)
1513  lParag = fParag = createParagraph(this, 0, 0);
1514 }

1525  Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceMode wsm;

1558  do{ \
1559  if (!hasNewPar) { \
1560  if (!textEditMode && curpar && curpar->length()>1 \
1561  && curpar->at(curpar->length()-2)->c == QChar::LineSeparator) \
1562  curpar->remove(curpar->length()-2, 1); \
1563  curpar = createParagraph(this, curpar, curpar->next()); \
1564  styles.append(vec); \
1565  vec = 0; \
1566  } \
1567  hasNewPar = true; \

1571  curpar->litem = (curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem); \
1572  curpar->str->setDirection((QChar::Direction)curtag.direction); \
1573  space = true; \
1574  tabExpansionColumn = 0; \
1575  delete vec; \
1576  vec = new QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *>(); \
1577  for (QStack<Q3TextDocumentTag>::Iterator it = tags.begin(); it != tags.end(); ++it) \
1578  vec->append(const_cast<Q3StyleSheetItem *>((*it).style)); \
1579  vec->append(const_cast<Q3StyleSheetItem *>(curtag.style)); \

1596 void Q3TextDocument::setRichTextInternal(const QString &text, Q3TextCursor* cursor, const Q3TextFormat *initialFormat)
1597 {
1598  Q3TextParagraph* curpar = lParag;
1599  int pos = 0;
1600  QStack<Q3TextDocumentTag> tags;
1601  if (!initialFormat)
1602  initialFormat = formatCollection()->defaultFormat();
1603  Q3TextDocumentTag initag(QLatin1String(""), sheet_->item(QLatin1String("")), *initialFormat);
1604  if (bodyText.isValid())
1605  initag.format.setColor(bodyText);
1606  Q3TextDocumentTag curtag = initag;
1607  bool space = true;
1608  bool canMergeLi = false;
1609 
1610  bool textEditMode = false;
1611  int tabExpansionColumn = 0;
1612 
1613  const QChar* doc = text.unicode();
1614  int length = text.length();
1615  bool hasNewPar = curpar->length() <= 1;
1616  QString anchorName;
1617 
1618  // style sheet handling for margin and line spacing calculation below
1619  Q3TextParagraph* stylesPar = curpar;
1620  QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *>* vec = 0;
1621  QList< QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *> *> styles;
1622 
1623  if (cursor) {
1624  cursor->splitAndInsertEmptyParagraph();
1625  Q3TextCursor tmp = *cursor;
1626  tmp.gotoPreviousLetter();
1627  stylesPar = curpar = tmp.paragraph();
1628  hasNewPar = true;
1629  textEditMode = true;
1630  } else {
1631  NEWPAR;
1632  }
1633 
1634  // set rtext spacing to false for the initial paragraph.
1635  curpar->rtext = false;
1636 
1637  QString wellKnownTags = QLatin1String("br hr wsp table qt body meta title");
1638 
1639  while (pos < length) {
1640  if (hasPrefix(doc, length, pos, QLatin1Char('<'))){
1641  if (!hasPrefix(doc, length, pos+1, QLatin1Char('/'))) {
1642  // open tag
1643  QMap<QString, QString> attr;
1644  QMap<QString, QString>::Iterator it, end = attr.end();
1645  bool emptyTag = false;
1646  QString tagname = parseOpenTag(doc, length, pos, attr, emptyTag);
1647  if (tagname.isEmpty())
1648  continue; // nothing we could do with this, probably parse error
1649 
1650  const Q3StyleSheetItem* nstyle = sheet_->item(tagname);
1651 
1652  if (nstyle) {
1653  // we might have to close some 'forgotten' tags
1654  while (!nstyle->allowedInContext(curtag.style)) {
1655  QString msg;
1656  msg.sprintf("QText Warning: Document not valid ('%s' not allowed in '%s' #%d)",
1657  tagname.ascii(), curtag.style->name().ascii(), pos);
1658  sheet_->error(msg);
1659  if (tags.isEmpty())
1660  break;
1661  curtag = tags.pop();
1662  }
1663 
1664  /* special handling for p and li for HTML
1665  compatibility. We do not want to embed blocks in
1666  p, and we do not want new blocks inside non-empty
1667  lis. Plus we want to merge empty lis sometimes. */
1668  if(nstyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem) {
1669  canMergeLi = true;
1670  } else if (nstyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock) {
1671  while (curtag.style->name() == QLatin1String("p")) {
1672  if (tags.isEmpty())
1673  break;
1674  curtag = tags.pop();
1675  }
1676 
1677  if (curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem) {
1678  // we are in a li and a new block comes along
1679  if (nstyle->name() == QString(QLatin1String("ul")) || nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("ol"))
1680  hasNewPar = false; // we want an empty li (like most browsers)
1681  if (!hasNewPar) {
1682  /* do not add new blocks inside
1683  non-empty lis */
1684  while (curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem) {
1685  if (tags.isEmpty())
1686  break;
1687  curtag = tags.pop();
1688  }
1689  } else if (canMergeLi) {
1690  /* we have an empty li and a block
1691  comes along, merge them */
1692  nstyle = curtag.style;
1693  }
1694  canMergeLi = false;
1695  }
1696  }
1697  }
1698 
1699 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1700  Q3TextCustomItem* custom = 0;
1701 #else
1702  bool custom = false;
1703 #endif
1704 
1705  // some well-known tags, some have a nstyle, some not
1706  if (wellKnownTags.contains(tagname)) {
1707  if (tagname == QLatin1String("br")) {
1708  emptyTag = space = true;
1709  int index = qMax(curpar->length(),1) - 1;
1710  Q3TextFormat format = curtag.format.makeTextFormat(nstyle, attr, scaleFontsFactor);
1711  curpar->append(QString(QChar(QChar::LineSeparator)));
1712  curpar->setFormat(index, 1, &format);
1713  hasNewPar = false;
1714  } else if (tagname == QLatin1String("hr")) {
1715  emptyTag = space = true;
1716 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1717  custom = tag(sheet_, tagname, attr, contxt, *factory_ , emptyTag, this);
1718 #endif
1719  } else if (tagname == QLatin1String("table")) {
1720  emptyTag = space = true;
1721 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1722  Q3TextFormat format = curtag.format.makeTextFormat( nstyle, attr, scaleFontsFactor);
1723  curpar->setAlignment(curtag.alignment);
1724  custom = parseTable(attr, format, doc, length, pos, curpar);
1725 #endif
1726  } else if (tagname == QLatin1String("qt") || tagname == QLatin1String("body")) {
1727  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("bgcolor"));
1728  if (it != end) {
1729  QBrush *b = new QBrush(QColor(*it));
1730  setPaper(b);
1731  }
1732  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("background"));
1733  if (it != end) {
1734 #ifndef QT_NO_MIME
1735  QImage img;
1736  QString bg = *it;
1737  const QMimeSource* m = factory_->data(bg, contxt);
1738  if (!m) {
1739  qCritical("QRichText: no mimesource for %s",
1740  QFile::encodeName(bg).data());
1741  } else {
1742  if (!Q3ImageDrag::decode(m, img)) {
1743  qCritical("Q3TextImage: cannot decode %s",
1744  QFile::encodeName(bg).data());
1745  }
1746  }
1747  if (!img.isNull()) {
1748  QBrush *b = new QBrush(QColor(), QPixmap(img));
1749  setPaper(b);
1750  }
1751 #endif
1752  }
1753  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("text"));
1754  if (it != end) {
1755  QColor c(*it);
1756  initag.format.setColor(c);
1757  curtag.format.setColor(c);
1758  bodyText = c;
1759  }
1760  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("link"));
1761  if (it != end)
1762  linkColor = QColor(*it);
1763  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("title"));
1764  if (it != end)
1765  attribs.insert(QLatin1String("title"), *it);
1766 
1767  if (textEditMode) {
1768  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("style"));
1769  if (it != end) {
1770  QString a = *it;
1771  int count = a.count(QLatin1Char(';')) + 1;
1772  for (int s = 0; s < count; s++) {
1773  QString style = a.section(QLatin1Char(';'), s, s);
1774  if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("font-size:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("pt"))) {
1775  scaleFontsFactor = double(formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->fn.pointSize()) /
1776  style.mid(10, style.length() - 12).toInt();
1777  }
1778  }
1779  }
1780  nstyle = 0; // ignore body in textEditMode
1781  }
1782  // end qt- and body-tag handling
1783  } else if (tagname == QLatin1String("meta")) {
1784  if (attr[QLatin1String("name")] == QLatin1String("qrichtext") && attr[QLatin1String("content")] == QLatin1String("1"))
1785  textEditMode = true;
1786  } else if (tagname == QLatin1String("title")) {
1787  QString title;
1788  while (pos < length) {
1789  if (hasPrefix(doc, length, pos, QLatin1Char('<')) && hasPrefix(doc, length, pos+1, QLatin1Char('/')) &&
1790  parseCloseTag(doc, length, pos) == QLatin1String("title"))
1791  break;
1792  title += doc[pos];
1793  ++pos;
1794  }
1795  attribs.insert(QLatin1String("title"), title);
1796  }
1797  } // end of well-known tag handling
1798 
1799 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1800  if (!custom) // try generic custom item
1801  custom = tag(sheet_, tagname, attr, contxt, *factory_ , emptyTag, this);
1802 #endif
1803  if (!nstyle && !custom) // we have no clue what this tag could be, ignore it
1804  continue;
1805 
1806  if (custom) {
1807 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
1808  int index = qMax(curpar->length(),1) - 1;
1809  Q3TextFormat format = curtag.format.makeTextFormat(nstyle, attr, scaleFontsFactor);
1810  curpar->append(QString(QLatin1Char('*')));
1811  Q3TextFormat* f = formatCollection()->format(&format);
1812  curpar->setFormat(index, 1, f);
1813  curpar->at(index)->setCustomItem(custom);
1814  if (!curtag.anchorHref.isEmpty())
1815  curpar->at(index)->setAnchor(QString(), curtag.anchorHref);
1816  if (!anchorName.isEmpty() ) {
1817  curpar->at(index)->setAnchor(anchorName, curpar->at(index)->anchorHref());
1818  anchorName.clear();
1819  }
1820  registerCustomItem(custom, curpar);
1821  hasNewPar = false;
1822 #endif
1823  } else if (!emptyTag) {
1824  /* if we do nesting, push curtag on the stack,
1825  otherwise reinint curag. */
1826  if (curtag.style->name() != tagname || nstyle->selfNesting()) {
1827  tags.push(curtag);
1828  } else {
1829  if (!tags.isEmpty())
1830  curtag = tags.top();
1831  else
1832  curtag = initag;
1833  }
1834 
1835  curtag.name = tagname;
1836  curtag.style = nstyle;
1837  curtag.name = tagname;
1838  curtag.style = nstyle;
1839  if (nstyle->whiteSpaceMode() != Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceModeUndefined)
1840  curtag.wsm = nstyle->whiteSpaceMode();
1841 
1842  /* netscape compatibility: eat a newline and only a newline if a pre block starts */
1843  if (curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpacePre &&
1844  nstyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock)
1845  eat(doc, length, pos, QLatin1Char('\n'));
1846 
1847  /* ignore whitespace for inline elements if there
1848  was already one*/
1849  if (!textEditMode &&
1850  (curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceNormal
1851  || curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceNoWrap)
1852  && (space || nstyle->displayMode() != Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayInline))
1853  eatSpace(doc, length, pos);
1854 
1855  curtag.format = curtag.format.makeTextFormat(nstyle, attr, scaleFontsFactor);
1856  if (nstyle->isAnchor()) {
1857  if (!anchorName.isEmpty())
1858  anchorName += QLatin1String("#") + attr[QLatin1String("name")];
1859  else
1860  anchorName = attr[QLatin1String("name")];
1861  curtag.anchorHref = attr[QLatin1String("href")];
1862  }
1863 
1864  if (nstyle->alignment() != Q3StyleSheetItem::Undefined)
1865  curtag.alignment = nstyle->alignment();
1866 
1867  if (nstyle->listStyle() != Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyleUndefined)
1868  curtag.liststyle = nstyle->listStyle();
1869 
1870  if (nstyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock
1871  || nstyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem) {
1872 
1873  if (nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("ol") ||
1874  nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("ul") ||
1875  nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("li")) {
1876  QString type = attr[QLatin1String("type")];
1877  if (!type.isEmpty()) {
1878  if (type == QLatin1String("1")) {
1879  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDecimal;
1880  } else if (type == QLatin1String("a")) {
1881  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListLowerAlpha;
1882  } else if (type == QLatin1String("A")) {
1883  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListUpperAlpha;
1884  } else {
1885  type = type.toLower();
1886  if (type == QLatin1String("square"))
1887  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListSquare;
1888  else if (type == QLatin1String("disc"))
1889  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDisc;
1890  else if (type == QLatin1String("circle"))
1891  curtag.liststyle = Q3StyleSheetItem::ListCircle;
1892  }
1893  }
1894  }
1895 
1896 
1897  /* Internally we treat ordered and bullet
1898  lists the same for margin calculations. In
1899  order to have fast pointer compares in the
1900  xMargin() functions we restrict ourselves to
1901  <ol>. Once we calculate the margins in the
1902  parser rathern than later, the unelegance of
1903  this approach goes awy
1904  */
1905  if (nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("ul"))
1906  curtag.style = sheet_->item(QLatin1String("ol"));
1907 
1908  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("align"));
1909  if (it != end) {
1910  QString align = (*it).toLower();
1911  if (align == QLatin1String("center"))
1912  curtag.alignment = Qt::AlignCenter;
1913  else if (align == QLatin1String("right"))
1914  curtag.alignment = Qt::AlignRight;
1915  else if (align == QLatin1String("justify"))
1916  curtag.alignment = Qt::AlignJustify;
1917  }
1918  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("dir"));
1919  if (it != end) {
1920  QString dir = (*it).toLower();
1921  if (dir == QLatin1String("rtl"))
1922  curtag.direction = QChar::DirR;
1923  else if (dir == QLatin1String("ltr"))
1924  curtag.direction = QChar::DirL;
1925  }
1926 
1927  NEWPAR;
1928 
1929  if (curtag.style && curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem) {
1930  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("value"));
1931  if (it != end)
1932  curpar->setListValue((*it).toInt());
1933  }
1934 
1935  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("style"));
1936  if (it != end) {
1937  QString a = *it;
1938  bool ok = true;
1939  int count = a.count(QLatin1Char(';'))+1;
1940  for (int s = 0; ok && s < count; s++) {
1941  QString style = a.section(QLatin1Char(';'), s, s);
1942  if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("margin-top:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("px")))
1943  curpar->utm = 1+style.mid(11, style.length() - 13).toInt(&ok);
1944  else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("margin-bottom:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("px")))
1945  curpar->ubm = 1+style.mid(14, style.length() - 16).toInt(&ok);
1946  else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("margin-left:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("px")))
1947  curpar->ulm = 1+style.mid(12, style.length() - 14).toInt(&ok);
1948  else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("margin-right:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("px")))
1949  curpar->urm = 1+style.mid(13, style.length() - 15).toInt(&ok);
1950  else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("text-indent:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("px")))
1951  curpar->uflm = 1+style.mid(12, style.length() - 14).toInt(&ok);
1952  }
1953  if (!ok) // be pressmistic
1954  curpar->utm = curpar->ubm = curpar->urm = curpar->ulm = 0;
1955  }
1956  } else if (nstyle->name() == QLatin1String("html")) {
1957  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("dir"));
1958  if (it != end) {
1959  QString dir = (*it).toLower();
1960  if (dir == QLatin1String("rtl"))
1961  curtag.direction = QChar::DirR;
1962  else if (dir == QLatin1String("ltr"))
1963  curtag.direction = QChar::DirL;
1964  }
1965  }
1966  }
1967  } else {
1968  QString tagname = parseCloseTag(doc, length, pos);
1969  if (tagname.isEmpty())
1970  continue; // nothing we could do with this, probably parse error
1971  if (!sheet_->item(tagname)) // ignore unknown tags
1972  continue;
1973  if (tagname == QLatin1String("li"))
1974  continue;
1975 
1976  // we close a block item. Since the text may continue, we need to have a new paragraph
1977  bool needNewPar = curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock
1978  || curtag.style->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem;
1979 
1980 
1981  // html slopiness: handle unbalanched tag closing
1982  while (curtag.name != tagname) {
1983  QString msg;
1984  msg.sprintf("QText Warning: Document not valid ('%s' not closed before '%s' #%d)",
1985  curtag.name.ascii(), tagname.ascii(), pos);
1986  sheet_->error(msg);
1987  if (tags.isEmpty())
1988  break;
1989  curtag = tags.pop();
1990  }
1991 
1992 
1993  // close the tag
1994  if (!tags.isEmpty())
1995  curtag = tags.pop();
1996  else
1997  curtag = initag;
1998 
1999  if (needNewPar) {
2000  if (textEditMode && (tagname == QLatin1String("p") || tagname == QLatin1String("div"))) // preserve empty paragraphs
2001  hasNewPar = false;
2002  NEWPAR;
2003  }
2004  }
2005  } else {
2006  // normal contents
2007  QString s;
2008  QChar c;
2009  while (pos < length && !hasPrefix(doc, length, pos, QLatin1Char('<'))){
2010  if (textEditMode) {
2011  // text edit mode: we handle all white space but ignore newlines
2012  c = parseChar(doc, length, pos, Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpacePre);
2013  if (c == QChar::LineSeparator)
2014  break;
2015  } else {
2016  int l = pos;
2017  c = parseChar(doc, length, pos, curtag.wsm);
2018 
2019  // in white space pre mode: treat any space as non breakable
2020  // and expand tabs to eight character wide columns.
2021  if (curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpacePre) {
2022  if (c == QLatin1Char('\t')) {
2023  c = QLatin1Char(' ');
2024  while((++tabExpansionColumn)%8)
2025  s += c;
2026  }
2027  if (c == QChar::LineSeparator)
2028  tabExpansionColumn = 0;
2029  else
2030  tabExpansionColumn++;
2031 
2032  }
2033  if (c == QLatin1Char(' ') || c == QChar::LineSeparator) {
2034  /* avoid overlong paragraphs by forcing a new
2035  paragraph after 4096 characters. This case can
2036  occur when loading undiscovered plain text
2037  documents in rich text mode. Instead of hanging
2038  forever, we do the trick.
2039  */
2040  if (curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceNormal && s.length() > 4096) do {
2041  if (doc[l] == QLatin1Char('\n')) {
2042  hasNewPar = false; // for a new paragraph ...
2043  NEWPAR;
2044  hasNewPar = false; // ... and make it non-reusable
2045  c = QLatin1Char('\n'); // make sure we break below
2046  break;
2047  }
2048  } while (++l < pos);
2049  }
2050  }
2051 
2052  if (c == QLatin1Char('\n'))
2053  break; // break on newlines, pre delievers a QChar::LineSeparator
2054 
2055  bool c_isSpace = c.isSpace() && c.unicode() != 0x00a0U && !textEditMode;
2056 
2057  if (curtag.wsm == Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceNormal && c_isSpace && space)
2058  continue;
2059  if (c == QLatin1Char('\r'))
2060  continue;
2061  space = c_isSpace;
2062  s += c;
2063  }
2064  if (!s.isEmpty() && curtag.style->displayMode() != Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayNone) {
2065  hasNewPar = false;
2066  int index = qMax(curpar->length(),1) - 1;
2067  curpar->append(s);
2068  if (curtag.wsm != Q3StyleSheetItem::WhiteSpaceNormal) {
2069  Q3TextString *str = curpar->string();
2070  for (int i = index; i < index + s.length(); ++i)
2071  str->at(i).nobreak = true;
2072  }
2073 
2074  Q3TextFormat* f = formatCollection()->format(&curtag.format);
2075  curpar->setFormat(index, s.length(), f, false); // do not use collection because we have done that already
2076  f->ref += s.length() -1; // that what friends are for...
2077  if (!curtag.anchorHref.isEmpty()) {
2078  for (int i = 0; i < int(s.length()); i++)
2079  curpar->at(index + i)->setAnchor(QString(), curtag.anchorHref);
2080  }
2081  if (!anchorName.isEmpty() ) {
2082  for (int i = 0; i < int(s.length()); i++)
2083  curpar->at(index + i)->setAnchor(anchorName, curpar->at(index + i)->anchorHref());
2084  anchorName.clear();
2085  }
2086  }
2087  }
2088  }
2089 
2090  if (hasNewPar && curpar != fParag && !cursor && stylesPar != curpar) {
2091  // cleanup unused last paragraphs
2092  curpar = curpar->p;
2093  delete curpar->n;
2094  }
2095 
2096  if (!anchorName.isEmpty() ) {
2097  curpar->at(curpar->length() - 1)->setAnchor(anchorName, curpar->at(curpar->length() - 1)->anchorHref());
2098  anchorName.clear();
2099  }
2100 
2101  setRichTextMarginsInternal(styles, stylesPar);
2102 
2103  if (cursor) {
2104  cursor->gotoPreviousLetter();
2105  cursor->remove();
2106  }
2107  while (!styles.isEmpty())
2108  delete styles.takeFirst();
2109  delete vec;
2110 }

2112 void Q3TextDocument::setRichTextMarginsInternal(QList< QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *> *>& styles, Q3TextParagraph* stylesPar)
2113 {
2114  // margin and line spacing calculation
2115  // qDebug("setRichTextMarginsInternal: styles.size() = %d", styles.size());
2116  QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *>* prevStyle = 0;
2117  int stylesIndex = 0;
2118  QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *>* curStyle = styles.size() ? styles.first() : 0;
2119  QVector<Q3StyleSheetItem *>* nextStyle =
2120  (++stylesIndex) < styles.size() ? styles.at(stylesIndex) : 0;
2121  while (stylesPar) {
2122  if (!curStyle) {
2123  stylesPar = stylesPar->next();
2124  prevStyle = curStyle;
2125  curStyle = nextStyle;
2126  nextStyle = (++stylesIndex) < styles.size() ? styles.at(stylesIndex) : 0;
2127  continue;
2128  }
2129 
2130  int i, mar;
2131  Q3StyleSheetItem* mainStyle = curStyle->size() ? (*curStyle)[curStyle->size()-1] : 0;
2132  if (mainStyle && mainStyle->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem)
2133  stylesPar->setListItem(true);
2134  int numLists = 0;
2135  for (i = 0; i < (int)curStyle->size(); ++i) {
2136  if ((*curStyle)[i]->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock
2137  && (*curStyle)[i]->listStyle() != Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyleUndefined)
2138  numLists++;
2139  }
2140  stylesPar->ldepth = numLists;
2141  if (stylesPar->next() && nextStyle) {
2142  // also set the depth of the next paragraph, required for the margin calculation
2143  numLists = 0;
2144  for (i = 0; i < (int)nextStyle->size(); ++i) {
2145  if ((*nextStyle)[i]->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock
2146  && (*nextStyle)[i]->listStyle() != Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyleUndefined)
2147  numLists++;
2148  }
2149  stylesPar->next()->ldepth = numLists;
2150  }
2151 
2152  // do the top margin
2153  Q3StyleSheetItem* item = mainStyle;
2154  int m;
2155  if (stylesPar->utm > 0) {
2156  m = stylesPar->utm-1;
2157  stylesPar->utm = 0;
2158  } else {
2159  m = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginTop));
2160  if (stylesPar->ldepth) {
2161  if (item->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem)
2162  m /= stylesPar->ldepth * stylesPar->ldepth;
2163  else
2164  m = 0;
2165  }
2166  }
2167  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 2 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2168  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2169  if (prevStyle && i < (int) prevStyle->size() &&
2170  ( item->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock &&
2171  (*prevStyle)[i] == item))
2172  break;
2173  // emulate CSS2' standard 0 vertical margin for multiple ul or ol tags
2174  if (item->listStyle() != Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyleUndefined &&
2175  (( i> 0 && (*curStyle)[i-1] == item) || (*curStyle)[i+1] == item))
2176  continue;
2177  mar = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginTop));
2178  m = qMax(m, mar);
2179  }
2180  stylesPar->utm = m - stylesPar->topMargin();
2181 
2182  // do the bottom margin
2183  item = mainStyle;
2184  if (stylesPar->ubm > 0) {
2185  m = stylesPar->ubm-1;
2186  stylesPar->ubm = 0;
2187  } else {
2188  m = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginBottom));
2189  if (stylesPar->ldepth) {
2190  if (item->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayListItem)
2191  m /= stylesPar->ldepth * stylesPar->ldepth;
2192  else
2193  m = 0;
2194  }
2195  }
2196  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 2 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2197  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2198  if (nextStyle && i < (int) nextStyle->size() &&
2199  ( item->displayMode() == Q3StyleSheetItem::DisplayBlock &&
2200  (*nextStyle)[i] == item))
2201  break;
2202  // emulate CSS2' standard 0 vertical margin for multiple ul or ol tags
2203  if (item->listStyle() != Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyleUndefined &&
2204  (( i> 0 && (*curStyle)[i-1] == item) || (*curStyle)[i+1] == item))
2205  continue;
2206  mar = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginBottom));
2207  m = qMax(m, mar);
2208  }
2209  stylesPar->ubm = m - stylesPar->bottomMargin();
2210 
2211  // do the left margin, simplyfied
2212  item = mainStyle;
2213  if (stylesPar->ulm > 0) {
2214  m = stylesPar->ulm-1;
2215  stylesPar->ulm = 0;
2216  } else {
2217  m = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginLeft));
2218  }
2219  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 2 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2220  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2221  m += qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginLeft));
2222  }
2223  stylesPar->ulm = m - stylesPar->leftMargin();
2224 
2225  // do the right margin, simplyfied
2226  item = mainStyle;
2227  if (stylesPar->urm > 0) {
2228  m = stylesPar->urm-1;
2229  stylesPar->urm = 0;
2230  } else {
2231  m = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginRight));
2232  }
2233  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 2 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2234  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2235  m += qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginRight));
2236  }
2237  stylesPar->urm = m - stylesPar->rightMargin();
2238 
2239  // do the first line margin, which really should be called text-indent
2240  item = mainStyle;
2241  if (stylesPar->uflm > 0) {
2242  m = stylesPar->uflm-1;
2243  stylesPar->uflm = 0;
2244  } else {
2245  m = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginFirstLine));
2246  }
2247  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 2 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2248  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2249  mar = qMax(0, item->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginFirstLine));
2250  m = qMax(m, mar);
2251  }
2252  stylesPar->uflm =m - stylesPar->firstLineMargin();
2253 
2254  // do the bogus line "spacing", which really is just an extra margin
2255  item = mainStyle;
2256  for (i = (int)curStyle->size() - 1 ; i >= 0; --i) {
2257  item = (*curStyle)[i];
2258  if (item->lineSpacing() != Q3StyleSheetItem::Undefined) {
2259  stylesPar->ulinespacing = item->lineSpacing();
2260  if (formatCollection() &&
2261  stylesPar->ulinespacing < formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->height())
2262  stylesPar->ulinespacing += formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->height();
2263  break;
2264  }
2265  }
2266 
2267  stylesPar = stylesPar->next();
2268  prevStyle = curStyle;
2269  curStyle = nextStyle;
2270  nextStyle = (++stylesIndex) < styles.size() ? styles.at(stylesIndex) : 0;
2271  }
2272 }

2285 QString Q3TextDocument::plainText() const
2286 {
2287  QString buffer;
2288  QString s;
2289  Q3TextParagraph *p = fParag;
2290  while (p) {
2291  if (!p->mightHaveCustomItems) {
2292  const Q3TextString *ts = p->string(); // workaround VC++ and Borland
2293  s = ts->toString(); // with false we don't fix spaces (nbsp)
2294  } else {
2295  for (int i = 0; i < p->length() - 1; ++i) {
2296 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
2297  if (p->at(i)->isCustom()) {
2298  if (p->at(i)->customItem()->isNested()) {
2299  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2300  Q3TextTable *t = (Q3TextTable*)p->at(i)->customItem();
2301  QList<Q3TextTableCell *> cells = t->tableCells();
2302  for (int idx = 0; idx < cells.size(); ++idx) {
2303  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
2304  s += c->richText()->plainText() + QLatin1String("\n");
2305  }
2306  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2307  }
2308  } else
2309 #endif
2310  {
2311  s += p->at(i)->c;
2312  }
2313  }
2314  }
2315  s.remove(s.length() - 1, 1);
2316  if (p->next())
2317  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2318  buffer += s;
2319  p = p->next();
2320  }
2321  return buffer;
2322 }

2324 static QString align_to_string(int a)
2325 {
2326  if (a & Qt::AlignRight)
2327  return QLatin1String(" align=\"right\"");
2328  if (a & Qt::AlignHCenter)
2329  return QLatin1String(" align=\"center\"");
2330  if (a & Qt::AlignJustify)
2331  return QLatin1String(" align=\"justify\"");
2332  return QString();

2335 static QString direction_to_string(int dir)
2336 {

2338  return (dir == QChar::DirL? QLatin1String(" dir=\"ltr\"") : QLatin1String(" dir=\"rtl\""));
2339  return QString();

2342 static QString list_value_to_string(int v)
2343 {
2344  if (v != -1)
2345  return QLatin1String(" listvalue=\"") + QString::number(v) + QLatin1Char('"');
2346  return QString();
2347 }
2348 
2349 static QString list_style_to_string(int v)
2350 {
2351  switch(v) {
2352  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDecimal: return QLatin1String("\"1\"");
2353  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListLowerAlpha: return QLatin1String("\"a\"");
2354  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListUpperAlpha: return QLatin1String("\"A\"");
2355  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDisc: return QLatin1String("\"disc\"");
2356  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListSquare: return QLatin1String("\"square\"");
2357  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListCircle: return QLatin1String("\"circle\"");
2358  default:
2359  return QString();
2360  }
2361 }
2362 
2363 static inline bool list_is_ordered(int v)
2364 {
2365  return v == Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDecimal ||
2366  v == Q3StyleSheetItem::ListLowerAlpha ||
2367  v == Q3StyleSheetItem::ListUpperAlpha;
2368 }

2370 
2371 static QString margin_to_string(Q3StyleSheetItem* style, int t, int b, int l, int r, int fl)
2372 {
2373  QString s;
2374  if (l > 0)
2375  s += QString(s.size() ? QLatin1String(";") : QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("margin-left:") +
2376  QString::number(l+qMax(0,style->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginLeft))) + QLatin1String("px");
2377  if (r > 0)
2378  s += QString(s.size() ? QLatin1String(";") : QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("margin-right:") +
2379  QString::number(r+qMax(0,style->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginRight))) + QLatin1String("px");
2380  if (t > 0)
2381  s += QString(s.size() ? QLatin1String(";") : QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("margin-top:") +
2382  QString::number(t+qMax(0,style->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginTop))) + QLatin1String("px");
2383  if (b > 0)
2384  s += QString(s.size() ? QLatin1String(";") : QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("margin-bottom:") +
2385  QString::number(b+qMax(0,style->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginBottom))) + QLatin1String("px");
2386  if (fl > 0)
2387  s += QString(s.size() ? QLatin1String(";") : QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("text-indent:") +
2388  QString::number(fl+qMax(0,style->margin(Q3StyleSheetItem::MarginFirstLine))) + QLatin1String("px");
2389  if (s.size())
2390  return QLatin1String(" style=\"") + s + QLatin1String("\"");
2391  return QString();
2392 }

2394 QString Q3TextDocument::richText() const
2395 {
2396  QString s = QLatin1String("");
2397  if (!par) {
2398  s += QLatin1String("<html><head><meta name=\"qrichtext\" content=\"1\" /></head><body style=\"font-size:");
2399  s += QString::number(formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->font().pointSize());
2400  s += QLatin1String("pt;font-family:");
2401  s += formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->font().family();
2402  s += QLatin1String("\">");
2403  }
2404  Q3TextParagraph* p = fParag;
2405 
2406  Q3StyleSheetItem* item_p = styleSheet()->item(QLatin1String("p"));
2407  Q3StyleSheetItem* item_div = styleSheet()->item(QLatin1String("div"));
2408  Q3StyleSheetItem* item_ul = styleSheet()->item(QLatin1String("ul"));
2409  Q3StyleSheetItem* item_ol = styleSheet()->item(QLatin1String("ol"));
2410  Q3StyleSheetItem* item_li = styleSheet()->item(QLatin1String("li"));
2411  if (!item_p || !item_div || !item_ul || !item_ol || !item_li) {
2412  qWarning("QTextEdit: cannot export HTML due to insufficient stylesheet (lack of p, div, ul, ol, or li)");
2413  return QString();
2414  }
2415  int pastListDepth = 0;
2416  int listDepth = 0;
2417 #if 0
2418  int futureListDepth = 0;
2419 #endif
2420  QVector<int> listStyles(10);
2421 
2422  while (p) {
2423  listDepth = p->listDepth();
2424  if (listDepth < pastListDepth) {
2425  for (int i = pastListDepth; i > listDepth; i--)
2426  s += list_is_ordered(listStyles[i]) ? QLatin1String("</ol>") : QLatin1String("</ul>");
2427  s += QLatin1Char('\n');
2428  } else if (listDepth > pastListDepth) {
2429  s += QLatin1Char('\n');
2430  listStyles.resize(qMax((int)listStyles.size(), listDepth+1));
2431  QString list_type;
2432  listStyles[listDepth] = p->listStyle();
2433  if (!list_is_ordered(p->listStyle()) || item_ol->listStyle() != p->listStyle())
2434  list_type = QLatin1String(" type=") + list_style_to_string(p->listStyle());
2435  for (int i = pastListDepth; i < listDepth; i++) {
2436  s += list_is_ordered(p->listStyle()) ? QLatin1String("<ol") : QLatin1String("<ul");
2437  s += list_type + QLatin1String(">");
2438  }
2439  } else {
2440  s += QLatin1Char('\n');
2441  }
2442 
2443  QString ps = p->richText();
2444 
2445 #if 0
2446  // for the bottom margin we need to know whether we are at the end of a list
2447  futureListDepth = 0;
2448  if (listDepth > 0 && p->next())
2449  futureListDepth = p->next()->listDepth();
2450 #endif
2451 
2452  if (richTextExportStart && richTextExportStart->paragraph() ==p &&
2453  richTextExportStart->index() == 0)
2454  s += QLatin1String("<!--StartFragment-->");
2455 
2456  if (p->isListItem()) {
2457  s += QLatin1String("<li");
2458  if (p->listStyle() != listStyles[listDepth])
2459  s += QLatin1String(" type=") + list_style_to_string(p->listStyle());
2460  s += align_to_string(p->alignment());
2461  s += margin_to_string(item_li, p->utm, p->ubm, p->ulm, p->urm, p->uflm);
2462  s += list_value_to_string(p->listValue());
2463  s += direction_to_string(p->direction());
2464  s += QLatin1String(">");
2465  s += ps;
2466  s += QLatin1String("</li>");
2467  } else if (p->listDepth()) {
2468  s += QLatin1String("<div");
2469  s += align_to_string(p->alignment());
2470  s += margin_to_string(item_div, p->utm, p->ubm, p->ulm, p->urm, p->uflm);
2471  s += direction_to_string(p->direction());
2472  s += QLatin1String(">");
2473  s += ps;
2474  s += QLatin1String("</div>");
2475  } else {
2476  // normal paragraph item
2477  s += QLatin1String("<p");
2478  s += align_to_string(p->alignment());
2479  s += margin_to_string(item_p, p->utm, p->ubm, p->ulm, p->urm, p->uflm);
2480  s += direction_to_string(p->direction());
2481  s += QLatin1String(">");
2482  s += ps;
2483  s += QLatin1String("</p>");
2484  }
2485  pastListDepth = listDepth;
2486  p = p->next();
2487  }
2488  while (listDepth > 0) {
2489  s += list_is_ordered(listStyles[listDepth]) ? QLatin1String("</ol>") : QLatin1String("</ul>");
2490  listDepth--;
2491  }
2492 
2493  if (!par)
2494  s += QLatin1String("\n</body></html>\n");
2495 
2496  return s;
2497 }

2559 void Q3TextDocument::selectionEnd(int id, int &paragId, int &index)
2560 {

2563  return;

2565  paragId = sel.swapped ? sel.startCursor.paragraph()->paragId() : sel.endCursor.paragraph()->paragId();
2566  index = sel.swapped ? sel.startCursor.index() : sel.endCursor.index();

2574 static void setSelectionEndHelper(int id, Q3TextDocumentSelection &sel, Q3TextCursor &start, Q3TextCursor &end)
2575 {
2576  Q3TextCursor c1 = start;
2577  Q3TextCursor c2 = end;
2578  if (sel.swapped) {
2579  c1 = end;
2580  c2 = start;
2581  }
2582 
2583  c1.paragraph()->removeSelection(id);
2584  c2.paragraph()->removeSelection(id);
2585  if (c1.paragraph() != c2.paragraph()) {
2586  c1.paragraph()->setSelection(id, c1.index(), c1.paragraph()->length() - 1);
2587  c2.paragraph()->setSelection(id, 0, c2.index());
2588  } else {
2589  c1.paragraph()->setSelection(id, qMin(c1.index(), c2.index()), qMax(c1.index(), c2.index()));
2590  }
2591 
2592  sel.startCursor = start;
2593  sel.endCursor = end;
2594  if (sel.startCursor.paragraph() == sel.endCursor.paragraph())
2595  sel.swapped = sel.startCursor.index() > sel.endCursor.index();
2596 }
2597 
2598 bool Q3TextDocument::setSelectionEnd(int id, const Q3TextCursor &cursor)
2599 {
2600  QMap<int, Q3TextDocumentSelection>::Iterator it = selections.find(id);
2601  if (it == selections.end())
2602  return false;
2603  Q3TextDocumentSelection &sel = *it;
2604 
2605  Q3TextCursor start = sel.startCursor;
2606  Q3TextCursor end = cursor;
2607 
2608  if (start == end) {
2609  removeSelection(id);
2610  setSelectionStart(id, cursor);
2611  return true;
2612  }
2613 
2614  if (sel.endCursor.paragraph() == end.paragraph()) {
2615  setSelectionEndHelper(id, sel, start, end);
2616  return true;
2617  }
2618 
2619  bool inSelection = false;
2620  Q3TextCursor c(this);
2621  Q3TextCursor tmp = sel.startCursor;
2622  if (sel.swapped)
2623  tmp = sel.endCursor;
2624  tmp.restoreState();
2625  Q3TextCursor tmp2 = cursor;
2626  tmp2.restoreState();
2627  c.setParagraph(tmp.paragraph()->paragId() < tmp2.paragraph()->paragId() ? tmp.paragraph() : tmp2.paragraph());
2628  bool hadStart = false;
2629  bool hadEnd = false;
2630  bool hadStartParag = false;
2631  bool hadEndParag = false;
2632  bool hadOldStart = false;
2633  bool hadOldEnd = false;
2634  bool leftSelection = false;
2635  sel.swapped = false;
2636  for (;;) {
2637  if (c == start)
2638  hadStart = true;
2639  if (c == end)
2640  hadEnd = true;
2641  if (c.paragraph() == start.paragraph())
2642  hadStartParag = true;
2643  if (c.paragraph() == end.paragraph())
2644  hadEndParag = true;
2645  if (c == sel.startCursor)
2646  hadOldStart = true;
2647  if (c == sel.endCursor)
2648  hadOldEnd = true;
2649 
2650  if (!sel.swapped &&
2651  ((hadEnd && !hadStart)
2652  || (hadEnd && hadStart && start.paragraph() == end.paragraph() && start.index() > end.index())))
2653  sel.swapped = true;
2654 
2655  if ((c == end && hadStartParag) || (c == start && hadEndParag)) {
2656  Q3TextCursor tmp = c;
2657  tmp.restoreState();
2658  if (tmp.paragraph() != c.paragraph()) {
2659  int sstart = tmp.paragraph()->selectionStart(id);
2660  tmp.paragraph()->removeSelection(id);
2661  tmp.paragraph()->setSelection(id, sstart, tmp.index());
2662  }
2663  }
2664 
2665  if (inSelection &&
2666  ((c == end && hadStart) || (c == start && hadEnd)))
2667  leftSelection = true;
2668  else if (!leftSelection && !inSelection && (hadStart || hadEnd))
2669  inSelection = true;
2670 
2671  bool noSelectionAnymore = hadOldStart && hadOldEnd && leftSelection && !inSelection && !c.paragraph()->hasSelection(id) && c.atParagEnd();
2672  c.paragraph()->removeSelection(id);
2673  if (inSelection) {
2674  if (c.paragraph() == start.paragraph() && start.paragraph() == end.paragraph()) {
2675  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, qMin(start.index(), end.index()), qMax(start.index(), end.index()));
2676  } else if (c.paragraph() == start.paragraph() && !hadEndParag) {
2677  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, start.index(), c.paragraph()->length() - 1);
2678  } else if (c.paragraph() == end.paragraph() && !hadStartParag) {
2679  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, end.index(), c.paragraph()->length() - 1);
2680  } else if (c.paragraph() == end.paragraph() && hadEndParag) {
2681  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, 0, end.index());
2682  } else if (c.paragraph() == start.paragraph() && hadStartParag) {
2683  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, 0, start.index());
2684  } else {
2685  c.paragraph()->setSelection(id, 0, c.paragraph()->length() - 1);
2686  }
2687  }
2688 
2689  if (leftSelection)
2690  inSelection = false;
2691 
2692  if (noSelectionAnymore)
2693  break;
2694  // *ugle*hack optimization
2695  Q3TextParagraph *p = c.paragraph();
2696  if ( p->mightHaveCustomItems || p == start.paragraph() || p == end.paragraph() || p == lastParagraph()) {
2697  c.gotoNextLetter();
2698  if (p == lastParagraph() && c.atParagEnd())
2699  break;
2700  } else {
2701  if (p->document()->parent())
2702  do {
2703  c.gotoNextLetter();
2704  } while (c.paragraph() == p);
2705  else
2706  c.setParagraph(p->next());
2707  }
2708  }
2709 
2710  if (!sel.swapped)
2711  sel.startCursor.paragraph()->setSelection(id, sel.startCursor.index(), sel.startCursor.paragraph()->length() - 1);
2712 
2713  sel.startCursor = start;
2714  sel.endCursor = end;
2715  if (sel.startCursor.paragraph() == sel.endCursor.paragraph())
2716  sel.swapped = sel.startCursor.index() > sel.endCursor.index();
2717 
2718  setSelectionEndHelper(id, sel, start, end);
2719 
2720  return true;
2721 }

2723 void Q3TextDocument::selectAll(int id)

2725  removeSelection(id);
2726 
2727  Q3TextDocumentSelection sel;
2728  sel.swapped = false;
2729  Q3TextCursor c(this);
2730 
2731  c.setParagraph(fParag);
2732  c.setIndex(0);
2733  sel.startCursor = c;

2735  c.setParagraph(lParag);

2753 bool Q3TextDocument::removeSelection(int id)
2754 {
2755  if (!selections.contains(id))
2756  return false;
2757 
2758  Q3TextDocumentSelection &sel = selections[id];
2759 
2760  Q3TextCursor start = sel.swapped ? sel.endCursor : sel.startCursor;
2761  Q3TextCursor end = sel.swapped ? sel.startCursor : sel.endCursor;
2762  Q3TextParagraph* p = 0;
2763  while (start != end) {
2764  if (p != start.paragraph()) {
2765  p = start.paragraph();
2766  p->removeSelection(id);
2767  //### avoid endless loop by all means necessary, did somebody mention refactoring?
2768  if (!parent() && p == lParag)
2769  break;
2770  }
2771  start.gotoNextLetter();
2772  }
2773  p = start.paragraph();
2774  p->removeSelection(id);
2775  selections.remove(id);
2776  return true;
2777 }

2779 QString Q3TextDocument::selectedText(int id, bool asRichText) const
2780 {
2781  QMap<int, Q3TextDocumentSelection>::ConstIterator it = selections.find(id);
2782  if (it == selections.end())
2783  return QString();
2784 
2785  Q3TextDocumentSelection sel = *it;
2786 
2787 
2788  Q3TextCursor c1 = sel.startCursor;
2789  Q3TextCursor c2 = sel.endCursor;
2790  if (sel.swapped) {
2791  c2 = sel.startCursor;
2792  c1 = sel.endCursor;
2793  }
2794 
2795  /* 3.0.3 improvement: Make it possible to get a reasonable
2796  selection inside a table. This approach is very conservative:
2797  make sure that both cursors have the same depth level and point
2798  to paragraphs within the same text document.
2799 
2800  Meaning if you select text in two table cells, you will get the
2801  entire table. This is still far better than the 3.0.2, where
2802  you always got the entire table.
2803 
2804  ### Fix this properly when refactoring
2805  */
2806  while (c2.nestedDepth() > c1.nestedDepth())
2807  c2.oneUp();
2808  while (c1.nestedDepth() > c2.nestedDepth())
2809  c1.oneUp();
2810  while (c1.nestedDepth() && c2.nestedDepth() &&
2811  c1.paragraph()->document() != c2.paragraph()->document()) {
2812  c1.oneUp();
2813  c2.oneUp();
2814  }
2815  // do not trust sel_swapped with tables. Fix this properly when refactoring as well
2816  if (c1.paragraph()->paragId() > c2.paragraph()->paragId() ||
2817  (c1.paragraph() == c2.paragraph() && c1.index() > c2.index())) {
2818  Q3TextCursor tmp = c1;
2819  c2 = c1;
2820  c1 = tmp;
2821  }
2822 
2823  // end selection 3.0.3 improvement
2824 
2825  if (asRichText && !parent()) {
2826  richTextExportStart = &c1;
2827  richTextExportEnd = &c2;
2828 
2829  QString sel = richText();
2830  int from = sel.indexOf(QLatin1String("<!--StartFragment-->"));
2831  if (from >= 0) {
2832  from += 20;
2833  // find the previous span and move it into the start fragment before we clip it
2834  QString prevspan;
2835  int pspan = sel.lastIndexOf(QLatin1String("<span"), from-21);
2836  if (pspan > sel.lastIndexOf(QLatin1String("</span"), from-21)) {
2837  int spanend = sel.indexOf(QLatin1Char('>'), pspan);
2838  prevspan = sel.mid(pspan, spanend - pspan + 1);
2839  }
2840  int to = sel.lastIndexOf(QLatin1String("<!--EndFragment-->"));
2841  if (from <= to)
2842  sel = QLatin1String("<!--StartFragment-->") + prevspan + sel.mid(from, to - from);
2843  }
2844  richTextExportStart = richTextExportEnd = 0;
2845  return sel;
2846  }
2847 
2848  QString s;
2849  if (c1.paragraph() == c2.paragraph()) {
2850  Q3TextParagraph *p = c1.paragraph();
2851  int end = c2.index();
2852  if (p->at(qMax(0, end - 1))->isCustom())
2853  ++end;
2854  if (!p->mightHaveCustomItems) {
2855  s += p->string()->toString().mid(c1.index(), end - c1.index());
2856  } else {
2857  for (int i = c1.index(); i < end; ++i) {
2858 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
2859  if (p->at(i)->isCustom()) {
2860  if (p->at(i)->customItem()->isNested()) {
2861  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2862  Q3TextTable *t = (Q3TextTable*)p->at(i)->customItem();
2863  QList<Q3TextTableCell *> cells = t->tableCells();
2864  for (int idx = 0; idx < cells.size(); ++idx) {
2865  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
2866  s += c->richText()->plainText() + QLatin1String("\n");
2867  }
2868  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2869  }
2870  } else
2871 #endif
2872  {
2873  s += p->at(i)->c;
2874  }
2875  }
2876  }
2877  } else {
2878  Q3TextParagraph *p = c1.paragraph();
2879  int start = c1.index();
2880  while (p) {
2881  int end = p == c2.paragraph() ? c2.index() : p->length() - 1;
2882  if (p == c2.paragraph() && p->at(qMax(0, end - 1))->isCustom())
2883  ++end;
2884  if (!p->mightHaveCustomItems) {
2885  s += p->string()->toString().mid(start, end - start);
2886  if (p != c2.paragraph())
2887  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2888  } else {
2889  for (int i = start; i < end; ++i) {
2890 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
2891  if (p->at(i)->isCustom()) {
2892  if (p->at(i)->customItem()->isNested()) {
2893  s += QLatin1String(QLatin1String("\n"));
2894  Q3TextTable *t = (Q3TextTable*)p->at(i)->customItem();
2895  QList<Q3TextTableCell *> cells = t->tableCells();
2896  for (int idx = 0; idx < cells.size(); ++idx) {
2897  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
2898  s += c->richText()->plainText() + QLatin1String("\n");
2899  }
2900  s += QLatin1String("\n");
2901  }
2902  } else
2903 #endif
2904  {
2905  s += p->at(i)->c;
2906  }
2907  }
2908  }
2909  start = 0;
2910  if (p == c2.paragraph())
2911  break;
2912  p = p->next();
2913  }
2914  }
2915  // ### workaround for plain text export until we get proper
2916  // mime types: turn unicode line seperators into the more
2917  // widely understood \n. Makes copy and pasting code snipplets
2918  // from within Assistent possible
2919  QChar* uc = (QChar*) s.unicode();
2920  for (int ii = 0; ii < s.length(); ii++) {
2921  if (uc[(int)ii] == QChar::LineSeparator)
2922  uc[(int)ii] = QLatin1Char('\n');
2923  else if ( uc[(int)ii] == QChar::Nbsp )
2924  uc[(int)ii] = QLatin1Char(' ');
2925  }
2926  return s;
2927 }

2929 void Q3TextDocument::setFormat(int id, Q3TextFormat *f, int flags)
2930 {
2931  QMap<int, Q3TextDocumentSelection>::ConstIterator it = selections.constFind(id);
2932  if (it == selections.constEnd())
2933  return;
2934 
2935  Q3TextDocumentSelection sel = *it;
2936 
2937  Q3TextCursor c1 = sel.startCursor;
2938  Q3TextCursor c2 = sel.endCursor;
2939  if (sel.swapped) {
2940  c2 = sel.startCursor;
2941  c1 = sel.endCursor;
2942  }
2943 
2944  c2.restoreState();
2945  c1.restoreState();
2946 
2947  if (c1.paragraph() == c2.paragraph()) {
2948  c1.paragraph()->setFormat(c1.index(), c2.index() - c1.index(), f, true, flags);
2949  return;
2950  }

2952  c1.paragraph()->setFormat(c1.index(), c1.paragraph()->length() - c1.index(), f, true, flags);
2953  Q3TextParagraph *p = c1.paragraph()->next();
2954  while (p && p != c2.paragraph()) {
2955  p->setFormat(0, p->length(), f, true, flags);
2956  p = p->next();
2957  }
2958  c2.paragraph()->setFormat(0, c2.index(), f, true, flags);

2961 void Q3TextDocument::removeSelectedText(int id, Q3TextCursor *cursor)
2962 {
2963  QMap<int, Q3TextDocumentSelection>::Iterator it = selections.find(id);
2964  if (it == selections.end())
2965  return;
2966 
2967  Q3TextDocumentSelection sel = *it;
2968  Q3TextCursor c1 = sel.startCursor;
2969  Q3TextCursor c2 = sel.endCursor;
2970  if (sel.swapped) {
2971  c2 = sel.startCursor;
2972  c1 = sel.endCursor;
2973  }
2974 
2975  // ### no support for editing tables yet
2976  if (c1.nestedDepth() || c2.nestedDepth())
2977  return;
2978 
2979  c2.restoreState();
2980  c1.restoreState();
2981 
2982  *cursor = c1;
2983  removeSelection(id);
2984 
2985  if (c1.paragraph() == c2.paragraph()) {
2986  c1.paragraph()->remove(c1.index(), c2.index() - c1.index());
2987  return;
2988  }
2989 
2990  if (c1.paragraph() == fParag && c1.index() == 0 &&
2991  c2.paragraph() == lParag && c2.index() == lParag->length() - 1)
2992  cursor->setValid(false);
2993 
2994  bool didGoLeft = false;
2995  if ( c1.index() == 0 && c1.paragraph() != fParag) {
2996  cursor->gotoPreviousLetter();
2997  didGoLeft = cursor->isValid();
2998  }
2999 
3000  c1.paragraph()->remove(c1.index(), c1.paragraph()->length() - 1 - c1.index());
3001  Q3TextParagraph *p = c1.paragraph()->next();
3002  int dy = 0;
3003  Q3TextParagraph *tmp;
3004  while (p && p != c2.paragraph()) {
3005  tmp = p->next();
3006  dy -= p->rect().height();
3007  delete p;
3008  p = tmp;
3009  }
3010  c2.paragraph()->remove(0, c2.index());
3011  while (p) {
3012  p->move(dy);
3013  p->invalidate(0);
3014  p->setEndState(-1);
3015  p = p->next();
3016  }
3017 
3018 
3019  c1.paragraph()->join(c2.paragraph());
3020 
3021  if (didGoLeft)
3022  cursor->gotoNextLetter();
3023 }

3068 bool Q3TextDocument::find(Q3TextCursor& cursor, const QString &expr, bool cs, bool wo, bool forward)
3069 {
3070  Qt::CaseSensitivity caseSensitive = cs ? Qt::CaseSensitive : Qt::CaseInsensitive;
3071  removeSelection(Standard);
3072  if (expr.isEmpty())
3073  return false;
3074  for (;;) {
3075  QString s = cursor.paragraph()->string()->toString();
3076  int start = cursor.index();
3077  for (;;) {
3078  int res = forward
3079  ? s.indexOf(expr, start, caseSensitive)
3080  : s.lastIndexOf(expr, start, caseSensitive);
3081  int end = res + expr.length();
3082  if (res == -1 || (!forward && start <= res))
3083  break;
3084  if (!wo || ((res == 0 || !s[res-1].isLetterOrNumber())
3085  && (end == (int)s.length() || !s[end].isLetterOrNumber()))) {
3086  removeSelection(Standard);
3087  cursor.setIndex(forward ? end : res);
3088  setSelectionStart(Standard, cursor);
3089  cursor.setIndex(forward ? res : end);
3090  setSelectionEnd(Standard, cursor);
3091  if (!forward)
3092  cursor.setIndex(res);
3093  return true;
3094  }
3095  start = res + (forward ? 1 : -1);
3096  }
3097  if (forward) {
3098  if (cursor.paragraph() == lastParagraph() && cursor.atParagEnd())
3099  break;
3100  cursor.gotoNextLetter();
3101  } else {
3102  if (cursor.paragraph() == firstParagraph() && cursor.atParagStart())
3103  break;
3104  cursor.gotoPreviousLetter();
3105  }
3106  }
3107  return false;
3108 }
