3122 bool Q3TextDocument::inSelection(int selId, const QPoint &pos) const
3123 {
3124  QMap<int, Q3TextDocumentSelection>::ConstIterator it = selections.find(selId);
3125  if (it == selections.end())
3126  return false;
3127 
3128  Q3TextDocumentSelection sel = *it;
3129  Q3TextParagraph *startParag = sel.startCursor.paragraph();
3130  Q3TextParagraph *endParag = sel.endCursor.paragraph();
3131  if (sel.startCursor.paragraph() == sel.endCursor.paragraph() &&
3132  sel.startCursor.paragraph()->selectionStart(selId) == sel.endCursor.paragraph()->selectionEnd(selId))
3133  return false;
3134  if (sel.endCursor.paragraph()->paragId() < sel.startCursor.paragraph()->paragId()) {
3135  endParag = sel.startCursor.paragraph();
3136  startParag = sel.endCursor.paragraph();
3137  }
3138 
3139  Q3TextParagraph *p = startParag;
3140  while (p) {
3141  if (p->rect().contains(pos)) {
3142  bool inSel = false;
3143  int selStart = p->selectionStart(selId);
3144  int selEnd = p->selectionEnd(selId);
3145  int y = 0;
3146  int h = 0;
3147  for (int i = 0; i < p->length(); ++i) {
3148  if (i == selStart)
3149  inSel = true;
3150  if (i == selEnd)
3151  break;
3152  if (p->at(i)->lineStart) {
3153  y = (*p->lineStarts.find(i))->y;
3154  h = (*p->lineStarts.find(i))->h;
3155  }
3156  if (pos.y() - p->rect().y() >= y && pos.y() - p->rect().y() <= y + h) {
3157  if (inSel && pos.x() >= p->at(i)->x &&
3158  pos.x() <= p->at(i)->x + p->at(i)->format()->width(p->at(i)->c))
3159  return true;
3160  }
3161  }
3162  }
3163  if (pos.y() < p->rect().y())
3164  break;
3165  if (p == endParag)
3166  break;
3167  p = p->next();
3168  }
3169 
3170  return false;
3171 }

3173 void Q3TextDocument::doLayout(QPainter *p, int w)
3174 {
3175  minw = wused = 0;
3176  if (!is_printer(p))
3177  p = 0;
3178  withoutDoubleBuffer = (p != 0);

3180  Q3TextFormat::setPainter(p);
3181  tStopWidth = formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->width( QLatin1Char('x') ) * 8;
3182  flow_->setWidth(w);

3184  vw = w;

3187  parag->invalidate(0);

3205 void Q3TextDocument::draw(QPainter *p, const QRect &rect, const QPalette &pal,
3206  const QBrush *paper)
3207 {
3208  if (!firstParagraph())
3209  return;
3210 
3211  if (paper) {
3212  p->setBrushOrigin(-qIntCast(p->translationX()),
3213  -qIntCast(p->translationY()));
3214 
3215  p->fillRect(rect, *paper);
3216  }
3217 
3218  QPainter * oldPainter = Q3TextFormat::painter();
3219  Q3TextFormat::setPainter(p);
3220 
3221  if (formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->color() != pal.text().color())
3222  setDefaultFormat(formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->font(), pal.text().color());
3223 
3224  Q3TextParagraph *parag = firstParagraph();
3225  while (parag) {
3226  if (!parag->isValid())
3227  parag->format();
3228  int y = parag->rect().y();
3229  QRect pr(parag->rect());
3230  pr.setX(0);
3231  pr.setWidth(QWIDGETSIZE_MAX);
3232  if (!rect.isNull() && !rect.intersects(pr)) {
3233  parag = parag->next();
3234  continue;
3235  }
3236  p->translate(0, y);
3237  if (rect.isValid())
3238  parag->paint(*p, pal, 0, false, rect.x(), rect.y(), rect.width(), rect.height());
3239  else
3240  parag->paint(*p, pal, 0, false);
3241  p->translate(0, -y);
3242  parag = parag->next();
3243  if (!flow()->isEmpty())
3244  flow()->drawFloatingItems(p, rect.x(), rect.y(), rect.width(), rect.height(), pal, false);
3245  }
3246  Q3TextFormat::setPainter(oldPainter);
3247 }

3249 void Q3TextDocument::drawParagraph(QPainter *painter, Q3TextParagraph *parag, int cx, int cy,
3250  int cw, int ch,
3251  QPixmap *&/*doubleBuffer*/, const QPalette &pal,
3252  bool drawCursor, Q3TextCursor *cursor, bool resetChanged)
3253 {
3254  if (resetChanged)
3255  parag->setChanged(false);
3256  QRect ir(parag->rect());
3257 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
3258  if (!parag->tableCell())
3259 #endif
3260  ir.setWidth(width());
3261 
3262  painter->translate(ir.x(), ir.y());
3263 
3264  if (!parag->document()->parent()) {
3265  const QPoint oldOrigin = painter->brushOrigin();
3266  painter->setBrushOrigin(-ir.topLeft());
3267  painter->fillRect(QRect(0, 0, ir.width(), ir.height()), parag->backgroundBrush(pal));
3268  painter->setBrushOrigin(oldOrigin);
3269  }
3270 
3271  painter->translate(-(ir.x() - parag->rect().x()),
3272  -(ir.y() - parag->rect().y()));
3273  parag->paint(*painter, pal, drawCursor ? cursor : 0, true, cx, cy, cw, ch);
3274 
3275  painter->translate(-ir.x(), -ir.y());
3276 
3277  parag->document()->nextDoubleBuffered = false;
3278 }
3279 
3280 Q3TextParagraph *Q3TextDocument::draw(QPainter *p, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch,
3281  const QPalette &pal, bool onlyChanged, bool drawCursor,
3282  Q3TextCursor *cursor, bool resetChanged)
3283 {
3284  if (withoutDoubleBuffer || (par && par->withoutDoubleBuffer)) {
3285  withoutDoubleBuffer = true;
3286  QRect r;
3287  draw(p, r, pal);
3288  return 0;
3289  }
3290  withoutDoubleBuffer = false;
3291 
3292  if (!firstParagraph())
3293  return 0;
3294 
3295  QPainter * oldPainter = Q3TextFormat::painter();
3296  Q3TextFormat::setPainter(p);
3297  if (formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->color() != pal.text().color())
3298  setDefaultFormat(formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->font(), pal.text().color());
3299 
3300  if (cx < 0 && cy < 0) {
3301  cx = 0;
3302  cy = 0;
3303  cw = width();
3304  ch = height();
3305  }
3306 
3307  Q3TextParagraph *lastFormatted = 0;
3308  Q3TextParagraph *parag = firstParagraph();
3309 
3310  QPixmap *doubleBuffer = 0;
3311 
3312  while (parag) {
3313  lastFormatted = parag;
3314  if (!parag->isValid())
3315  parag->format();
3316 
3317  QRect pr = parag->rect();
3318  pr.setWidth(parag->document()->width());
3319  if (pr.y() > cy + ch)
3320  goto floating;
3321  QRect clipr(cx, cy, cw, ch);
3322  if (!pr.intersects(clipr) || (onlyChanged && !parag->hasChanged())) {
3323  pr.setWidth(parag->document()->width());
3324  parag = parag->next();
3325  continue;
3326  }
3327 
3328  drawParagraph(p, parag, cx, cy, cw, ch, doubleBuffer, pal, drawCursor,
3329  cursor, resetChanged);
3330  parag = parag->next();
3331  }
3332 
3333  parag = lastParagraph();
3334 
3335  floating:
3336  if (parag->rect().y() + parag->rect().height() < parag->document()->height()) {
3337  if (!parag->document()->parent()) {
3338  QRect fillRect = QRect(0, parag->rect().y() + parag->rect().height(), parag->document()->width(),
3339  parag->document()->height() - (parag->rect().y() + parag->rect().height()));
3340  if (QRect(cx, cy, cw, ch).intersects(fillRect))
3341  p->fillRect(fillRect, pal.brush(QPalette::Base));
3342  }
3343  if (!flow()->isEmpty()) {
3344  QRect cr(cx, cy, cw, ch);
3345  flow()->drawFloatingItems(p, cr.x(), cr.y(), cr.width(), cr.height(), pal, false);
3346  }
3347  }
3348 
3349  if (buf_pixmap && buf_pixmap->height() > 300) {
3350  delete buf_pixmap;
3351  buf_pixmap = 0;
3352  }
3353 
3354  Q3TextFormat::setPainter(oldPainter);
3355  return lastFormatted;
3356 }

3461 bool Q3TextDocument::focusNextPrevChild(bool next)
3462 {
3463  if (!focusIndicator.parag) {
3464  if (next) {
3465  focusIndicator.parag = fParag;
3466  focusIndicator.start = 0;
3467  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3468  } else {
3469  focusIndicator.parag = lParag;
3470  focusIndicator.start = lParag->length();
3471  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3472  }
3473  } else {
3474  focusIndicator.parag->setChanged(true);
3475  }
3476  focusIndicator.href.clear();
3477  focusIndicator.name.clear();
3478 
3479  if (next) {
3480  Q3TextParagraph *p = focusIndicator.parag;
3481  int index = focusIndicator.start + focusIndicator.len;
3482  while (p) {
3483  for (int i = index; i < p->length(); ++i) {
3484  if (p->at(i)->isAnchor()) {
3485  p->setChanged(true);
3486  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3487  focusIndicator.start = i;
3488  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3489  focusIndicator.href = p->at(i)->anchorHref();
3490  focusIndicator.name = p->at(i)->anchorName();
3491  while (i < p->length()) {
3492  if (!p->at(i)->isAnchor())
3493  return true;
3494  focusIndicator.len++;
3495  i++;
3496  }
3497 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
3498  } else if (p->at(i)->isCustom()) {
3499  if (p->at(i)->customItem()->isNested()) {
3500  Q3TextTable *t = (Q3TextTable*)p->at(i)->customItem();
3501  QList<Q3TextTableCell *> cells = t->tableCells();
3502  // first try to continue
3503  int idx;
3504  bool resetCells = true;
3505  for (idx = 0; idx < cells.size(); ++idx) {
3506  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
3507  if (c->richText()->hasFocusParagraph()) {
3508  if (c->richText()->focusNextPrevChild(next)) {
3509  p->setChanged(true);
3510  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3511  focusIndicator.start = i;
3512  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3513  focusIndicator.href = c->richText()->focusHref();
3514  focusIndicator.name = c->richText()->focusName();
3515  return true;
3516  } else {
3517  resetCells = false;
3518  ++idx;
3519  break;
3520  }
3521  }
3522  }
3523  // now really try
3524  if (resetCells)
3525  idx = 0;
3526  for (; idx < cells.size(); ++idx) {
3527  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
3528  if (c->richText()->focusNextPrevChild(next)) {
3529  p->setChanged(true);
3530  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3531  focusIndicator.start = i;
3532  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3533  focusIndicator.href = c->richText()->focusHref();
3534  focusIndicator.name = c->richText()->focusName();
3535  return true;
3536  }
3537  }
3538  }
3539 #endif
3540  }
3541  }
3542  index = 0;
3543  p = p->next();
3544  }
3545  } else {
3546  Q3TextParagraph *p = focusIndicator.parag;
3547  int index = focusIndicator.start - 1;
3548  if (focusIndicator.len == 0 && index < focusIndicator.parag->length() - 1)
3549  index++;
3550  while (p) {
3551  for (int i = index; i >= 0; --i) {
3552  if (p->at(i)->isAnchor()) {
3553  p->setChanged(true);
3554  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3555  focusIndicator.start = i;
3556  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3557  focusIndicator.href = p->at(i)->anchorHref();
3558  focusIndicator.name = p->at(i)->anchorName();
3559  while (i >= -1) {
3560  if (i < 0 || !p->at(i)->isAnchor()) {
3561  focusIndicator.start++;
3562  return true;
3563  }
3564  if (i < 0)
3565  break;
3566  focusIndicator.len++;
3567  focusIndicator.start--;
3568  i--;
3569  }
3570 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
3571  } else if (p->at(i)->isCustom()) {
3572  if (p->at(i)->customItem()->isNested()) {
3573  Q3TextTable *t = (Q3TextTable*)p->at(i)->customItem();
3574  QList<Q3TextTableCell *> cells = t->tableCells();
3575  // first try to continue
3576  int idx;
3577  bool resetCells = true;
3578  for (idx = cells.size()-1; idx >= 0; --idx) {
3579  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
3580  if (c->richText()->hasFocusParagraph()) {
3581  if (c->richText()->focusNextPrevChild(next)) {
3582  p->setChanged(true);
3583  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3584  focusIndicator.start = i;
3585  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3586  focusIndicator.href = c->richText()->focusHref();
3587  focusIndicator.name = c->richText()->focusName();
3588  return true;
3589  } else {
3590  resetCells = false;
3591  --idx;
3592  break;
3593  }
3594  }
3595  }
3596  // now really try
3597  if (resetCells)
3598  idx = cells.size()-1;
3599  for (; idx >= 0; --idx) {
3600  Q3TextTableCell *c = cells.at(idx);
3601  if (c->richText()->focusNextPrevChild(next)) {
3602  p->setChanged(true);
3603  focusIndicator.parag = p;
3604  focusIndicator.start = i;
3605  focusIndicator.len = 0;
3606  focusIndicator.href = c->richText()->focusHref();
3607  focusIndicator.name = c->richText()->focusName();
3608  return true;
3609  }
3610  }
3611  }
3612 #endif
3613  }
3614  }
3615  p = p->prev();
3616  if (p)
3617  index = p->length() - 1;
3618  }
3619  }
3620 
3621  focusIndicator.parag = 0;
3622 
3623  return false;
3624 }

3639 int Q3TextFormat::width(const QChar &c) const
3640 {
3641  if (c.unicode() == 0xad) // soft hyphen
3642  return 0;
3643  if (!pntr || !pntr->isActive()) {
3644  if (c == QLatin1Char('\t'))
3645  return fm.width(QLatin1Char(' '));
3646  if (ha == AlignNormal) {
3647  int w;
3648  if (c.row())
3649  w = fm.width(c);
3650  else
3651  w = widths[c.unicode()];
3652  if (w == 0 && !c.row()) {
3653  w = fm.width(c);
3654  ((Q3TextFormat*)this)->widths[c.unicode()] = w;
3655  }
3656  return w;
3657  } else {
3658  QFont f(fn);
3659  if (usePixelSizes)
3660  f.setPixelSize((f.pixelSize() * 2) / 3);
3661  else
3662  f.setPointSize((f.pointSize() * 2) / 3);
3663  QFontMetrics fm_(f);
3664  return fm_.width(c);
3665  }
3666  }
3667 
3668  QFont f(fn);
3669  if (ha != AlignNormal) {
3670  if (usePixelSizes)
3671  f.setPixelSize((f.pixelSize() * 2) / 3);
3672  else
3673  f.setPointSize((f.pointSize() * 2) / 3);
3674  }
3675  applyFont(f);
3676 
3677  return pntr_fm->width(c);

3790 int Q3TextString::appendParagraphs( Q3TextParagraph *start, Q3TextParagraph *end )
3791 {
3792  int paragCount = 0;
3793  int newLength = data.size();
3794  for (Q3TextParagraph *p = start; p != end; p = p->next()) {
3795  newLength += p->length();
3796  ++paragCount;
3797  }
3798 
3799  const int oldLength = data.size();
3800  data.resize(newLength);
3801 
3802  Q3TextStringChar *d = &data[oldLength];
3803  for (Q3TextParagraph *p = start; p != end; p = p->next()) {
3804  const Q3TextStringChar * const src = p->at(0);
3805  int i = 0;
3806  for (; i < p->length() - 1; ++i) {
3807  d[i].c = src[i].c;
3808  d[i].x = 0;
3809  d[i].lineStart = 0;
3810  d[i].rightToLeft = 0;
3811  d[i].type = Q3TextStringChar::Regular;
3812  d[i].nobreak = false;
3813  d[i].p.format = src[i].format();
3814  if (d[i].p.format)
3815  d[i].p.format->addRef();
3816  }
3817  d[i].x = 0;
3818  d[i].lineStart = 0;
3819  d[i].nobreak = false;
3820  d[i].type = Q3TextStringChar::Regular;
3821  d[i].p.format = 0;
3822  d[i].rightToLeft = 0;
3823  d[i].c = QLatin1Char('\n');
3824  d += p->length();
3825  }
3826 
3827  bidiDirty = true;
3828  return paragCount;
3829 }

3831 void Q3TextString::truncate(int index)
3832 {
3833  index = qMax(index, 0);
3834  index = qMin(index, (int)data.size() - 1);
3835  if (index < (int)data.size()) {
3836  for (int i = index + 1; i < (int)data.size(); ++i) {
3837  Q3TextStringChar &ch = data[i];
3838 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
3839  if (!(ch.type == Q3TextStringChar::Regular)) {
3840  delete ch.customItem();
3841  if (ch.p.custom->format)
3842  ch.p.custom->format->removeRef();
3843  delete ch.p.custom;
3844  ch.p.custom = 0;
3845  } else
3846 #endif
3847  if (ch.format()) {
3848  ch.format()->removeRef();
3849  }
3850  }
3851  }
3852  data.resize(index);
3853  bidiDirty = true;
3854 }

3856 void Q3TextString::remove(int index, int len)
3857 {
3858  for (int i = index; i < (int)data.size() && i - index < len; ++i) {
3859  Q3TextStringChar &ch = data[i];
3860 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
3861  if (!(ch.type == Q3TextStringChar::Regular)) {
3862  delete ch.customItem();
3863  if (ch.p.custom->format)
3864  ch.p.custom->format->removeRef();
3865  delete ch.p.custom;
3866  ch.p.custom = 0;
3867  } else
3868 #endif
3869  if (ch.format()) {
3870  ch.format()->removeRef();
3871  }
3872  }
3873  memmove(data.data() + index, data.data() + index + len,
3874  sizeof(Q3TextStringChar) * (data.size() - index - len));
3875  data.resize(data.size() - len);
3876  bidiDirty = true;
3877 }

3886  delete ch.customItem();
3887  if (ch.p.custom->format)
3888  ch.p.custom->format->removeRef();

3890  ch.p.custom = 0;
3891  } else
3892 #endif

4079 int Q3TextString::width(int idx) const
4080 {
4081  int w = 0;
4082  Q3TextStringChar *c = &at(idx);
4083  if (!c->charStop || c->c.unicode() == 0xad || c->c.unicode() == 0x2028)
4084  return 0;
4085 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
4086  if(c->isCustom()) {
4087  if(c->customItem()->placement() == Q3TextCustomItem::PlaceInline)
4088  w = c->customItem()->width;
4089  } else
4090 #endif
4091  {
4092  int r = c->c.row();
4093  if(r < 0x06
4094 #ifndef Q_WS_WIN
4095  // Uniscribe's handling of Asian makes the condition below fail.
4096  || (r > 0x1f && !(r > 0xd7 && r < 0xe0))
4097 #endif
4098  ) {
4099  w = c->format()->width(c->c);
4100  } else {
4101  // complex text. We need some hacks to get the right metric here
4102  w = c->format()->width(toString(), idx);
4103  }
4104  }
4105  return w;
4106 }

4274 void Q3TextParagraph::join(Q3TextParagraph *s)
4275 {
4276  int oh = r.height() + s->r.height();
4277  n = s->n;
4278  if (n)
4279  n->p = this;
4280  else if (hasdoc)
4281  document()->setLastParagraph(this);
4282 
4283  int start = str->length();
4284  if (length() > 0 && at(length() - 1)->c == QLatin1Char(' ')) {
4285  remove(length() - 1, 1);
4286  --start;
4287  }
4288  append(s->str->toString(), true);
4289 
4290  for (int i = 0; i < s->length(); ++i) {
4291  if (!hasdoc || document()->useFormatCollection()) {
4292  s->str->at(i).format()->addRef();
4293  str->setFormat(i + start, s->str->at(i).format(), true);
4294  }
4295 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
4296  if (s->str->at(i).isCustom()) {
4297  Q3TextCustomItem * item = s->str->at(i).customItem();
4298  str->at(i + start).setCustomItem(item);
4299  s->str->at(i).loseCustomItem();
4300  if (hasdoc) {
4301  document()->unregisterCustomItem(item, s);
4302  document()->registerCustomItem(item, this);
4303  }
4304  }
4305  if (s->str->at(i).isAnchor()) {
4306  str->at(i + start).setAnchor(s->str->at(i).anchorName(),
4307  s->str->at(i).anchorHref());
4308  }
4309 #endif
4310  }
4311 
4312  if (!extraData() && s->extraData()) {
4313  setExtraData(s->extraData());
4314  s->setExtraData(0);
4315  } else if (extraData() && s->extraData()) {
4316  extraData()->join(s->extraData());
4317  }
4318  delete s;
4319  invalidate(0);
4320  r.setHeight(oh);
4321  needPreProcess = true;
4322  if (n) {
4323  Q3TextParagraph *s = n;
4324  s->invalidate(0);
4325  while (s) {
4326  s->id = s->p->id + 1;
4327  s->state = -1;
4328  s->needPreProcess = true;
4329  s->changed = true;
4330  s->invalidateStyleCache();
4331  s = s->n;
4332  }
4333  }
4334  format();
4335  state = -1;
4336 }

4338 void Q3TextParagraph::move(int &dy)
4339 {

4341  return;

4345  if (mFloatingItems) {
4346  for (int idx = 0; idx < mFloatingItems->size(); ++idx) {
4347  Q3TextCustomItem *i = mFloatingItems->at(idx);
4348  i->ypos += dy;
4349  }
4350  }
4351 #endif
4352  if (p)
4353  p->lastInFrame = true;
4354 
4355  // do page breaks if required
4356  if (hasdoc && document()->isPageBreakEnabled()) {
4357  int shift;
4358  if ((shift = document()->formatter()->formatVertically( document(), this))) {
4359  if (p)
4360  p->setChanged(true);
4361  dy += shift;
4362  }
4363  }
4364 }

4366 void Q3TextParagraph::format(int start, bool doMove)
4367 {
4368  if (!str || str->length() == 0 || !formatter())
4369  return;
4370 
4371  if (hasdoc &&
4372  document()->preProcessor() &&
4373  (needPreProcess || state == -1))
4374  document()->preProcessor()->process(document(), this, invalid <= 0 ? 0 : invalid);
4375  needPreProcess = false;
4376 
4377  if (invalid == -1)
4378  return;
4379 
4380  r.moveTopLeft(QPoint(documentX(), p ? p->r.y() + p->r.height() : documentY()));
4381  if (p)
4382  p->lastInFrame = false;
4383 
4384  movedDown = false;
4385  bool formattedAgain = false;
4386 
4387  formatAgain:
4388 
4389  r.setWidth(documentWidth());
4390 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
4391  if (hasdoc && mFloatingItems) {
4392  for (int idx = 0; idx < mFloatingItems->size(); ++idx) {
4393  Q3TextCustomItem *i = mFloatingItems->at(idx);
4394  i->ypos = r.y();
4395  if (i->placement() == Q3TextCustomItem::PlaceRight) {
4396  i->xpos = r.x() + r.width() - i->width;
4397  }
4398  }
4399  }
4400 #endif
4401  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*> oldLineStarts = lineStarts;
4402  lineStarts.clear();
4403  int y = formatter()->format(document(), this, start, oldLineStarts);
4404 
4405 
4406  r.setWidth(qMax(r.width(), formatter()->minimumWidth()));
4407 
4408 
4409  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*>::Iterator it = oldLineStarts.begin();
4410 
4411  for (; it != oldLineStarts.end(); ++it)
4412  delete *it;
4413 
4414  if (!hasdoc) { // qt_format_text bounding rect handling
4415  it = lineStarts.begin();
4416  int usedw = 0;
4417  for (; it != lineStarts.end(); ++it)
4418  usedw = qMax(usedw, (*it)->w);
4419  if (r.width() <= 0) {
4420  // if the user specifies an invalid rect, this means that the
4421  // bounding box should grow to the width that the text actually
4422  // needs
4423  r.setWidth(usedw);
4424  } else {
4425  r.setWidth(qMin(usedw, r.width()));
4426  }
4427  }
4428 
4429  if (y != r.height())
4430  r.setHeight(y);
4431 
4432  if (!visible) {
4433  r.setHeight(0);
4434  } else {
4435  int minw = minwidth = formatter()->minimumWidth();
4436  int wused = formatter()->widthUsed();
4437  wused = qMax(minw, wused);
4438  if (hasdoc) {
4439  document()->setMinimumWidth(minw, wused, this);
4440  } else {
4441  pseudoDocument()->minw = qMax(pseudoDocument()->minw, minw);
4442  pseudoDocument()->wused = qMax(pseudoDocument()->wused, wused);
4443  }
4444  }
4445 
4446  // do page breaks if required
4447  if (hasdoc && document()->isPageBreakEnabled()) {
4448  int shift = document()->formatter()->formatVertically(document(), this);
4449  if (shift && !formattedAgain) {
4450  formattedAgain = true;
4451  goto formatAgain;
4452  }
4453  }
4454 
4455  if (n && doMove && n->invalid == -1 && r.y() + r.height() != n->r.y()) {
4456  int dy = (r.y() + r.height()) - n->r.y();
4457  Q3TextParagraph *s = n;
4458  bool makeInvalid = p && p->lastInFrame;
4459  while (s && dy) {
4460  if (!s->isFullWidth())
4461  makeInvalid = true;
4462  if (makeInvalid)
4463  s->invalidate(0);
4464  s->move(dy);
4465  if (s->lastInFrame)
4466  makeInvalid = true;
4467  s = s->n;
4468  }
4469  }
4470 
4471  firstFormat = false;
4472  changed = true;
4473  invalid = -1;
4474  //##### string()->setTextChanged(false);
4475 }
4476 
4477 int Q3TextParagraph::lineHeightOfChar(int i, int *bl, int *y) const
4478 {
4479  if (!isValid())
4480  ((Q3TextParagraph*)this)->format();
4481 
4482  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*>::ConstIterator it = lineStarts.end();
4483  --it;
4484  for (;;) {
4485  if (i >= it.key()) {
4486  if (bl)
4487  *bl = (*it)->baseLine;
4488  if (y)
4489  *y = (*it)->y;
4490  return (*it)->h;
4491  }
4492  if (it == lineStarts.begin())
4493  break;
4494  --it;
4495  }
4496 
4497  qWarning("Q3TextParagraph::lineHeightOfChar: couldn't find lh for %d", i);
4498  return 15;
4499 }

4501 Q3TextStringChar *Q3TextParagraph::lineStartOfChar(int i, int *index, int *line) const
4502 {
4503  if (!isValid())
4504  ((Q3TextParagraph*)this)->format();
4505 
4506  int l = (int)lineStarts.count() - 1;

4508  --it;
4509  for (;;) {
4510  if (i >= it.key()) {
4511  if (index)
4512  *index = it.key();
4513  if (line)
4514  *line = l;
4515  return &str->at(it.key());
4516  }
4517  if (it == lineStarts.begin())
4518  break;
4519  --it;
4520  --l;
4521  }

4523  qWarning("Q3TextParagraph::lineStartOfChar: couldn't find %d", i);
4524  return 0;

4535 Q3TextStringChar *Q3TextParagraph::lineStartOfLine(int line, int *index) const
4536 {

4554 int Q3TextParagraph::leftGap() const
4555 {
4556  if (!isValid())
4557  ((Q3TextParagraph*)this)->format();
4558 
4559  if (str->length() == 0)
4560  return 0;
4561 
4562  int line = 0;
4563  int x = str->length() ? str->at(0).x : 0; /* set x to x of first char */
4564  if (str->isBidi()) {
4565  for (int i = 1; i < str->length()-1; ++i)
4566  x = qMin(x, str->at(i).x);
4567  return x;
4568  }
4569 
4570  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*>::ConstIterator it = lineStarts.begin();
4571  while (line < (int)lineStarts.count()) {
4572  int i = it.key(); /* char index */
4573  x = qMin(x, str->at(i).x);
4574  ++it;
4575  ++line;
4576  }
4577  return x;
4578 }

4580 void Q3TextParagraph::setFormat(int index, int len, Q3TextFormat *f, bool useCollection, int flags)
4581 {
4582  if (!f)
4583  return;
4584  if (index < 0)
4585  index = 0;
4586  if (index > str->length() - 1)
4587  index = str->length() - 1;
4588  if (index + len >= str->length())
4589  len = str->length() - index;
4590 
4591  Q3TextFormatCollection *fc = 0;
4592  if (useCollection)
4593  fc = formatCollection();
4594  Q3TextFormat *of;
4595  for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
4596  of = str->at(i + index).format();
4597  if (!changed && (!of || f->key() != of->key()))
4598  changed = true;
4599  if (invalid == -1 &&
4600  (f->font().family() != of->font().family() ||
4601  f->font().pointSize() != of->font().pointSize() ||
4602  f->font().weight() != of->font().weight() ||
4603  f->font().italic() != of->font().italic() ||
4604  f->vAlign() != of->vAlign())) {
4605  invalidate(0);
4606  }
4607  if (flags == -1 || flags == Q3TextFormat::Format || !fc) {
4608  if (fc)
4609  f = fc->format(f);
4610  str->setFormat(i + index, f, useCollection);
4611  } else {
4612  Q3TextFormat *fm = fc->format(of, f, flags);
4613  str->setFormat(i + index, fm, useCollection);
4614  }
4615  }
4616 }

4632 void Q3TextParagraph::paint(QPainter &painter, const QPalette &pal, Q3TextCursor *cursor,
4633  bool drawSelections, int clipx, int clipy, int clipw, int cliph)
4634 {
4635  if (!visible)
4636  return;
4637  int i, y, h, baseLine, xstart, xend = 0;
4638  i = y =h = baseLine = 0;
4639  QRect cursorRect;
4640  drawSelections &= (mSelections != 0);
4641  // macintosh full-width selection style
4642  bool fullWidthStyle = QApplication::style()->styleHint(QStyle::SH_RichText_FullWidthSelection);
4643  int fullSelectionWidth = 0;
4644  if (drawSelections && fullWidthStyle)
4645  fullSelectionWidth = (hasdoc ? document()->width() : r.width());
4646 
4647  QString qstr = str->toString();
4648  qstr.detach();
4649  // ### workaround so that \n are not drawn, actually this should
4650  // be fixed in QFont somewhere (under Windows you get ugly boxes
4651  // otherwise)
4652  QChar* uc = (QChar*) qstr.unicode();
4653  for (int ii = 0; ii < qstr.length(); ii++)
4654  if (uc[(int)ii]== QLatin1Char(QLatin1Char('\n')) || uc[(int)ii] == QLatin1Char('\t'))
4655  uc[(int)ii] = 0x20;
4656 
4657  int line = -1;
4658  int paintStart = 0;
4659  Q3TextStringChar *chr = 0;
4660  Q3TextStringChar *nextchr = at(0);
4661  for (i = 0; i < length(); i++) {
4662  chr = nextchr;
4663  if (i < length()-1)
4664  nextchr = at(i+1);
4665 
4666  // we flush at end of document
4667  bool flush = (i == length()-1);
4668  bool ignoreSoftHyphen = false;
4669  if (!flush) {
4670  // we flush at end of line
4671  flush |= nextchr->lineStart;
4672  // we flush on format changes
4673  flush |= (nextchr->format() != chr->format());
4674  // we flush on link changes
4675  flush |= (nextchr->isLink() != chr->isLink());
4676  // we flush on start of run
4677  flush |= (nextchr->bidiLevel != chr->bidiLevel);
4678  // we flush on bidi changes
4679  flush |= (nextchr->rightToLeft != chr->rightToLeft);
4680  // we flush before and after tabs
4681  flush |= (chr->c == QLatin1Char('\t') || nextchr->c == QLatin1Char('\t'));
4682  // we flush on soft hyphens
4683  if (chr->c.unicode() == 0xad) {
4684  flush = true;
4685  if (!nextchr->lineStart)
4686  ignoreSoftHyphen = true;
4687  }
4688  // we flush on custom items
4689  flush |= chr->isCustom();
4690  // we flush before custom items
4691  flush |= nextchr->isCustom();
4692  // when painting justified, we flush on spaces
4693  if ((alignment() & Qt::AlignJustify) == Qt::AlignJustify)
4694  flush |= chr->whiteSpace;
4695  }
4696 
4697  // init a new line
4698  if (chr->lineStart) {
4699  ++line;
4700  paintStart = i;
4701  lineInfo(line, y, h, baseLine);
4702  if (clipy != -1 && cliph != 0 && y + r.y() - h > clipy + cliph) { // outside clip area, leave
4703  break;
4704  }
4705 
4706  // if this is the first line and we are a list item, draw the the bullet label
4707  if (line == 0 && isListItem()) {
4708  int x = chr->x;
4709  if (str->isBidi()) {
4710  if (str->isRightToLeft()) {
4711  x = chr->x + str->width(0);
4712  for (int k = 1; k < length(); ++k) {
4713  if (str->at(k).lineStart)
4714  break;
4715  x = qMax(x, str->at(k).x + str->width(k));
4716  }
4717  } else {
4718  x = chr->x;
4719  for (int k = 1; k < length(); ++k) {
4720  if (str->at(k).lineStart)
4721  break;
4722  x = qMin(x, str->at(k).x);
4723  }
4724  }
4725  }
4726  drawLabel(&painter, x, y, 0, 0, baseLine, pal);
4727  }
4728  }
4729 
4730  // check for cursor mark
4731  if (cursor && this == cursor->paragraph() && i == cursor->index()) {
4732  Q3TextStringChar *c = i == 0 ? chr : chr - 1;
4733  cursorRect.setRect(cursor->x() , y + baseLine - c->format()->ascent(),
4734  1, c->format()->height());
4735  }
4736 
4737  if (flush) { // something changed, draw what we have so far
4738  if (chr->rightToLeft) {
4739  xstart = chr->x;
4740  xend = at(paintStart)->x + str->width(paintStart);
4741  } else {
4742  xstart = at(paintStart)->x;
4743  xend = chr->x;
4744  if (i < length() - 1) {
4745  if (!str->at(i + 1).lineStart &&
4746  str->at(i + 1).rightToLeft == chr->rightToLeft)
4747  xend = str->at(i + 1).x;
4748  else
4749  xend += str->width(i);
4750  }
4751  }
4752 
4753  if ((clipx == -1 || clipw <= 0 || (xend >= clipx && xstart <= clipx + clipw)) &&
4754  (clipy == -1 || clipy < y+r.y()+h)) {
4755  if (!chr->isCustom())
4756  drawString(painter, qstr, paintStart, i - paintStart + (ignoreSoftHyphen ? 0 : 1), xstart, y,
4757  baseLine, xend-xstart, h, drawSelections, fullSelectionWidth,
4758  chr, pal, chr->rightToLeft);
4759 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
4760  else if (chr->customItem()->placement() == Q3TextCustomItem::PlaceInline) {
4761  bool inSelection = false;
4762  if (drawSelections) {
4763  QMap<int, Q3TextParagraphSelection>::ConstIterator it = mSelections->constFind(Q3TextDocument::Standard);
4764  inSelection = (it != mSelections->constEnd() && (*it).start <= i && (*it).end > i);
4765  }
4766  chr->customItem()->draw(&painter, chr->x, y,
4767  clipx == -1 ? clipx : (clipx - r.x()),
4768  clipy == -1 ? clipy : (clipy - r.y()),
4769  clipw, cliph, pal, inSelection);
4770  }
4771 #endif
4772  }
4773  paintStart = i+1;
4774  }
4775 
4776  }
4777 
4778  // time to draw the cursor
4779  const int cursor_extent = 4;
4780  if (!cursorRect.isNull() && cursor &&
4781  ((clipx == -1 || clipw == -1) || (cursorRect.right()+cursor_extent >= clipx && cursorRect.left()-cursor_extent <= clipx + clipw))) {
4782  painter.fillRect(cursorRect, pal.color(QPalette::Text));
4783  painter.save();
4784  if (string()->isBidi()) {
4785  if (at(cursor->index())->rightToLeft) {
4786  painter.setPen(Qt::black);
4787  painter.drawLine(cursorRect.x(), cursorRect.y(), cursorRect.x() - cursor_extent / 2, cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent / 2);
4788  painter.drawLine(cursorRect.x(), cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent, cursorRect.x() - cursor_extent / 2, cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent / 2);
4789  } else {
4790  painter.setPen(Qt::black);
4791  painter.drawLine(cursorRect.x(), cursorRect.y(), cursorRect.x() + cursor_extent / 2, cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent / 2);
4792  painter.drawLine(cursorRect.x(), cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent, cursorRect.x() + cursor_extent / 2, cursorRect.y() + cursor_extent / 2);
4793  }
4794  }
4795  painter.restore();
4796  }
4797 }

4801 void Q3TextParagraph::setColorForSelection(QColor &color, QPainter &painter,
4802  const QPalette &pal, int selection)
4803 {
4804  if (selection < 0)
4805  return;
4806  color = (hasdoc && selection != Q3TextDocument::Standard) ?
4807  document()->selectionColor(selection) :
4808  pal.color(QPalette::Highlight);
4809  QColor text = (hasdoc && document()->hasSelectionTextColor(selection)) ? document()->selectionTextColor(selection) : pal.color(QPalette::HighlightedText);
4810  if (text.isValid())
4811  painter.setPen(text);

4814 void Q3TextParagraph::drawString(QPainter &painter, const QString &str, int start, int len,
4815  int xstart, int y, int baseLine, int w, int h,
4816  bool drawSelections, int fullSelectionWidth,
4817  Q3TextStringChar *formatChar, const QPalette& pal,
4818  bool rightToLeft)
4819 {
4820  bool plainText = hasdoc ? document()->textFormat() == Qt::PlainText : false;
4821  Q3TextFormat* format = formatChar->format();
4822 
4823  int textFlags = int(rightToLeft ? Qt::TextForceRightToLeft : Qt::TextForceLeftToRight);
4824 
4825  if (!plainText || (hasdoc && format->color() != document()->formatCollection()->defaultFormat()->color()))
4826  painter.setPen(QPen(format->color()));
4827  else
4828  painter.setPen(pal.text().color());
4829  painter.setFont(format->font());
4830 
4831  if (hasdoc && formatChar->isAnchor() && !formatChar->anchorHref().isEmpty()) {
4832  if (format->useLinkColor())
4833  painter.setPen(document()->linkColor.isValid() ? document()->linkColor :
4834  pal.link().color());
4835  if (document()->underlineLinks()) {
4836  QFont fn = format->font();
4837  fn.setUnderline(true);
4838  painter.setFont(fn);
4839  }
4840  }
4841 
4842  int real_length = len;
4843  if (len && !rightToLeft && start + len == length()) // don't draw the last character (trailing space)
4844  len--;
4845  if (len && str.unicode()[start+len-1] == QChar::LineSeparator)
4846  len--;
4847 
4848 
4849  Q3TextFormat::VerticalAlignment vAlign = format->vAlign();
4850  if (vAlign != Q3TextFormat::AlignNormal) {
4851  // sub or superscript
4852  QFont f(painter.font());
4853  if (format->fontSizesInPixels())
4854  f.setPixelSize((f.pixelSize() * 2) / 3);
4855  else
4856  f.setPointSize((f.pointSize() * 2) / 3);
4857  painter.setFont(f);
4858  int h = painter.fontMetrics().height();
4859  baseLine += (vAlign == Q3TextFormat::AlignSubScript) ? h/6 : -h/2;
4860  }
4861 
4862  bool allSelected = false;
4863  if (drawSelections) {
4864  QMap<int, Q3TextParagraphSelection>::ConstIterator it = mSelections->constFind(Q3TextDocument::Standard);
4865  allSelected = (it != mSelections->constEnd() && (*it).start <= start && (*it).end >= start+len);
4866  }
4867  if (!allSelected)
4868  painter.drawText(QPointF(xstart, y + baseLine), str.mid(start, len), textFlags, /*justificationPadding*/0);
4869 
4870 #ifdef BIDI_DEBUG
4871  painter.save();
4872  painter.setPen (Qt::red);
4873  painter.drawLine(xstart, y, xstart, y + baseLine);
4874  painter.drawLine(xstart, y + baseLine/2, xstart + 10, y + baseLine/2);
4875  int w = 0;
4876  int i = 0;
4877  while(i < len)
4878  w += painter.fontMetrics().charWidth(str, start + i++);
4879  painter.setPen (Qt::blue);
4880  painter.drawLine(xstart + w - 1, y, xstart + w - 1, y + baseLine);
4881  painter.drawLine(xstart + w - 1, y + baseLine/2, xstart + w - 1 - 10, y + baseLine/2);
4882  painter.restore();
4883 #endif
4884 
4885  // check if we are in a selection and draw it
4886  if (drawSelections) {
4887  QMap<int, Q3TextParagraphSelection>::ConstIterator it = mSelections->constEnd();
4888  while (it != mSelections->constBegin()) {
4889  --it;
4890  int selStart = (*it).start;
4891  int selEnd = (*it).end;
4892  int tmpw = w;
4893 
4894  selStart = qMax(selStart, start);
4895  int real_selEnd = qMin(selEnd, start+real_length);
4896  selEnd = qMin(selEnd, start+len);
4897  bool extendRight = false;
4898  bool extendLeft = false;
4899  bool selWrap = (real_selEnd == length()-1 && n && n->hasSelection(it.key()));
4900  if (selWrap
4901  || ((real_selEnd < this->str->length()) && this->str->at(real_selEnd).lineStart)) {
4902  extendRight = (fullSelectionWidth != 0);
4903  if (!extendRight && !rightToLeft)
4904  tmpw += painter.fontMetrics().width(QLatin1Char(' '));
4905  }
4906  if (fullSelectionWidth && (selStart == 0 || this->str->at(selStart).lineStart)) {
4907  extendLeft = true;
4908  }
4909  if (this->str->isRightToLeft() != rightToLeft)
4910  extendLeft = extendRight = false;
4911 
4912  if (this->str->isRightToLeft()) {
4913  bool tmp = extendLeft;
4914  extendLeft = extendRight;
4915  extendRight = tmp;
4916  }
4917 
4918  if (selStart < real_selEnd ||
4919  (selWrap && fullSelectionWidth && extendRight &&
4920  // don't draw the standard selection on a printer=
4921  (it.key() != Q3TextDocument::Standard || !is_printer(&painter)))) {
4922  int selection = it.key();
4923  QColor color;
4924  setColorForSelection(color, painter, pal, selection);
4925  if (selStart != start || selEnd != start + len || selWrap) {
4926  // have to clip
4927  painter.save();
4928  int cs, ce;
4929  if (rightToLeft) {
4930  cs = (selEnd != start + len) ?
4931  this->str->at(this->str->previousCursorPosition(selEnd)).x : xstart;
4932  ce = (selStart != start) ?
4933  this->str->at(this->str->previousCursorPosition(selStart)).x : xstart+tmpw;
4934  } else {
4935  cs = (selStart != start) ? this->str->at(selStart).x : xstart;
4936  ce = (selEnd != start + len) ? this->str->at(selEnd).x : xstart+tmpw;
4937  }
4938  QRect r(cs, y, ce-cs, h);
4939  if (extendLeft)
4940  r.setLeft(0);
4941  if (extendRight)
4942  r.setRight(fullSelectionWidth);
4943  QRegion reg(r);
4944  if (painter.hasClipping())
4945  reg &= painter.clipRegion();
4946  painter.setClipRegion(reg);
4947  }
4948  int xleft = xstart;
4949  if (extendLeft) {
4950  tmpw += xstart;
4951  xleft = 0;
4952  }
4953  if (extendRight)
4954  tmpw = fullSelectionWidth - xleft;
4955  if(color.isValid())
4956  painter.fillRect(xleft, y, tmpw, h, color);
4957  painter.drawText(QPointF(xstart, y + baseLine), str.mid(start, len), textFlags, /*justificationPadding*/0);
4958  if (selStart != start || selEnd != start + len || selWrap)
4959  painter.restore();
4960  }
4961  }
4962  }
4963 
4964  if (format->isMisspelled()) {
4965  painter.save();
4966  painter.setPen(QPen(Qt::red, 1, Qt::DotLine));
4967  painter.drawLine(xstart, y + baseLine + 1, xstart + w, y + baseLine + 1);
4968  painter.restore();
4969  }
4970 
4971  if (hasdoc && formatChar->isAnchor() && !formatChar->anchorHref().isEmpty() &&
4972  document()->focusIndicator.parag == this &&
4973  ((document()->focusIndicator.start >= start &&
4974  document()->focusIndicator.start + document()->focusIndicator.len <= start + len)
4975  || (document()->focusIndicator.start <= start &&
4976  document()->focusIndicator.start + document()->focusIndicator.len >= start + len))) {
4977  QStyleOptionFocusRect opt;
4978  opt.rect.setRect(xstart, y, w, h);
4979 #ifndef Q_WS_WIN
4980  opt.state = QStyle::State_None;
4981 #else
4982  // force drawing a focus rect but only on windows because it's
4983  // configurable by the user in windows settings (see
4984  // SH_UnderlineShortcut style hint) and we want to override
4985  // this settings.
4986  opt.state = QStyle::State_KeyboardFocusChange;
4987 #endif
4988  opt.palette = pal;
4989  QApplication::style()->drawPrimitive(QStyle::PE_FrameFocusRect, &opt, &painter);
4990  }
4991 }

4993 void Q3TextParagraph::drawLabel(QPainter* p, int x, int y, int w, int h, int base,
4994  const QPalette& pal)
4995 {
4996  QRect r (x, y, w, h);
4997  Q3StyleSheetItem::ListStyle s = listStyle();
4998 
4999  p->save();
5000  Q3TextFormat *format = at(0)->format();
5001  if (format) {
5002  p->setPen(format->color());
5003  p->setFont(format->font());
5004  }
5005  QFontMetrics fm(p->fontMetrics());
5006  int size = fm.lineSpacing() / 3;
5007 
5008  bool rtl = str->isRightToLeft();
5009 
5010  switch (s) {
5011  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDecimal:
5012  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListLowerAlpha:
5013  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListUpperAlpha:
5014  {
5015  if (list_val == -1) { // uninitialised list value, calcluate the right one
5016  int depth = listDepth();
5017  list_val--;
5018  // ### evil, square and expensive. This needs to be done when formatting, not when painting
5019  Q3TextParagraph* s = prev();
5020  int depth_s;
5021  while (s && (depth_s = s->listDepth()) >= depth) {
5022  if (depth_s == depth && s->isListItem())
5023  list_val--;
5024  s = s->prev();
5025  }
5026  }
5027 
5028  int n = list_val;
5029  if (n < -1)
5030  n = -n - 1;
5031  QString l;
5032  switch (s) {
5033  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListLowerAlpha:
5034  if (n < 27) {
5035  l = QLatin1Char(('a' + (char) (n-1)));
5036  break;
5037  }
5038  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListUpperAlpha:
5039  if (n < 27) {
5040  l = QLatin1Char(('A' + (char) (n-1)));
5041  break;
5042  }
5043  break;
5044  default: //Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDecimal:
5045  l.setNum(n);
5046  break;
5047  }
5048  if (rtl)
5049  l.prepend(QLatin1String(" ."));
5050  else
5051  l += QString::fromLatin1(". ");
5052  int x = (rtl ? r.left() : r.right() - fm.width(l));
5053  p->drawText(x, r.top() + base, l);
5054  }
5055  break;
5056  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListSquare:
5057  {
5058  int x = rtl ? r.left() + size : r.right() - size*2;
5059  QRect er(x, r.top() + fm.height() / 2 - size / 2, size, size);
5060  p->fillRect(er , pal.brush(QPalette::Text));
5061  }
5062  break;
5063  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListCircle:
5064  {
5065  int x = rtl ? r.left() + size : r.right() - size*2;
5066  QRect er(x, r.top() + fm.height() / 2 - size / 2, size, size);
5067  p->drawEllipse(er);
5068  }
5069  break;
5070  case Q3StyleSheetItem::ListDisc:
5071  default:
5072  {
5073  p->setBrush(pal.brush(QPalette::Text));
5074  int x = rtl ? r.left() + size : r.right() - size*2;
5075  QRect er(x, r.top() + fm.height() / 2 - size / 2, size, size);
5076  p->drawEllipse(er);
5077  p->setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
5078  }
5079  break;
5080  }
5081 
5082  p->restore();
5083 }

5140 int Q3TextParagraph::nextTab(int, int x)
5141 {
5142  int *ta = tArray;
5143  if (hasdoc) {
5144  if (!ta)
5145  ta = document()->tabArray();
5146  tabStopWidth = document()->tabStopWidth();
5147  }
5148  if (ta) {
5149  int i = 0;
5150  while (ta[i]) {
5151  if (ta[i] >= x)
5152  return tArray[i];
5153  ++i;
5154  }
5155  return tArray[0];
5156  } else {
5157  int n;
5158  if (tabStopWidth != 0)
5159  n = x / tabStopWidth;
5160  else
5161  return x;
5162  return tabStopWidth * (n + 1);
5163  }

5186 QString Q3TextParagraph::richText() const
5187 {
5188  QString s;
5189  Q3TextStringChar *formatChar = 0;
5190  QString spaces;
5191  bool doStart = richTextExportStart && richTextExportStart->paragraph() == this;
5192  bool doEnd = richTextExportEnd && richTextExportEnd->paragraph() == this;
5193  int i;
5194  QString lastAnchorName;
5195  for (i = 0; i < length()-1; ++i) {
5196  if (doStart && i && richTextExportStart->index() == i)
5197  s += QLatin1String("<!--StartFragment-->");
5198  if (doEnd && richTextExportEnd->index() == i)
5199  s += QLatin1String("<!--EndFragment-->");
5200  Q3TextStringChar *c = &str->at(i);
5201  if (c->isAnchor() && !c->anchorName().isEmpty() && c->anchorName() != lastAnchorName) {
5202  lastAnchorName = c->anchorName();
5203  if (c->anchorName().contains(QLatin1Char('#'))) {
5204  QStringList l = c->anchorName().split(QLatin1Char('#'));
5205  for (QStringList::ConstIterator it = l.constBegin(); it != l.constEnd(); ++it)
5206  s += QLatin1String("<a name=\"") + *it + QLatin1String("\"></a>");
5207  } else {
5208  s += QLatin1String("<a name=\"") + c->anchorName() + QLatin1String("\"></a>");
5209  }
5210  }
5211  if (!formatChar) {
5212  s += c->format()->makeFormatChangeTags(formatCollection()->defaultFormat(),
5213  0, QString(), c->anchorHref());
5214  formatChar = c;
5215  } else if ((formatChar->format()->key() != c->format()->key()) ||
5216  (c->anchorHref() != formatChar->anchorHref())) {
5217  s += c->format()->makeFormatChangeTags(formatCollection()->defaultFormat(),
5218  formatChar->format() , formatChar->anchorHref(), c->anchorHref());
5219  formatChar = c;
5220  }
5221  if (c->c == QLatin1Char('<'))
5222  s += QLatin1String("&lt;");
5223  else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('>'))
5224  s += QLatin1String("&gt;");
5225  else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('&'))
5226  s += QLatin1String("&amp;");
5227  else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('\"'))
5228  s += QLatin1String("&quot;");
5229 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
5230  else if (c->isCustom())
5231  s += c->customItem()->richText();
5232 #endif
5233  else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('\n') || c->c == QChar::LineSeparator)
5234  s += QLatin1String("<br />"); // space on purpose for compatibility with Netscape, Lynx & Co.
5235  else
5236  s += c->c;
5237  }
5238  if (doEnd && richTextExportEnd->index() == i)
5239  s += QLatin1String("<!--EndFragment-->");
5240  if (formatChar)
5241  s += formatChar->format()->makeFormatEndTags(formatCollection()->defaultFormat(), formatChar->anchorHref());
5242  return s;
5243 }

5391 QTextLineStart *Q3TextFormatter::formatLine(Q3TextParagraph *parag, Q3TextString *string, QTextLineStart *line,
5392  Q3TextStringChar *startChar, Q3TextStringChar *lastChar, int align, int space)
5393 {
5394  if (lastChar < startChar)
5395  return new QTextLineStart;
5396 
5397  int start = (startChar - &string->at(0));
5398  int last = (lastChar - &string->at(0));
5399 
5400  // ignore white space at the end of the line.
5401  Q3TextStringChar *ch = lastChar;
5402  while (ch > startChar && ch->whiteSpace) {
5403  space += ch->format()->width(QLatin1Char(' '));
5404  --ch;
5405  }
5406 
5407  if (space < 0)
5408  space = 0;
5409 
5410  // do alignment Auto == Left in this case
5411  if (align & Qt::AlignHCenter || align & Qt::AlignRight) {
5412  if (align & Qt::AlignHCenter)
5413  space /= 2;
5414  for (int j = start; j <= last; ++j)
5415  string->at(j).x += space;
5416  } else if (align & Qt::AlignJustify) {
5417  int numSpaces = 0;
5418  // End at "last-1", the last space ends up with a width of 0
5419  for (int j = last-1; j >= start; --j) {
5420  // Start at last tab, if any.
5421  Q3TextStringChar &ch = string->at(j);
5422  if (ch.c == QLatin1Char('\t')) {
5423  start = j+1;
5424  break;
5425  }
5426  if(ch.whiteSpace)
5427  numSpaces++;
5428  }
5429  int toAdd = 0;
5430  for (int k = start + 1; k <= last; ++k) {
5431  Q3TextStringChar &ch = string->at(k);
5432  if(numSpaces && ch.whiteSpace) {
5433  int s = space / numSpaces;
5434  toAdd += s;
5435  space -= s;
5436  numSpaces--;
5437  }
5438  string->at(k).x += toAdd;
5439  }
5440  }
5441 
5442  if (last >= 0 && last < string->length())
5443  line->w = string->at(last).x + string->width(last);
5444  else
5445  line->w = 0;
5446 
5447  return new QTextLineStart;
5448 }

5456  parag->lineStartList().insert(index, ls);
5457  } else {

5459  parag->lineStartList().erase(it);
5460  parag->lineStartList().insert(index, ls);

5465 /* Standard pagebreak algorithm using Q3TextFlow::adjustFlow. Returns
5466  the shift of the paragraphs bottom line.
5467  */
5468 int Q3TextFormatter::formatVertically(Q3TextDocument* doc, Q3TextParagraph* parag)
5469 {
5470  int oldHeight = parag->rect().height();
5471  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*>& lineStarts = parag->lineStartList();
5472  QMap<int, QTextLineStart*>::Iterator it = lineStarts.begin();
5473  int h = parag->prev() ? qMax(parag->prev()->bottomMargin(),parag->topMargin()) / 2: 0;
5474  for (; it != lineStarts.end() ; ++it ) {
5475  QTextLineStart * ls = it.value();
5476  ls->y = h;
5477  Q3TextStringChar *c = &parag->string()->at(it.key());
5478 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
5479  if (c && c->customItem() && c->customItem()->ownLine()) {
5480  int h = c->customItem()->height;
5481  c->customItem()->pageBreak(parag->rect().y() + ls->y + ls->baseLine - h, doc->flow());
5482  int delta = c->customItem()->height - h;
5483  ls->h += delta;
5484  if (delta)
5485  parag->setMovedDown(true);
5486  } else
5487 #endif
5488  {
5489 
5490  int shift = doc->flow()->adjustFlow(parag->rect().y() + ls->y, ls->w, ls->h);
5491  ls->y += shift;
5492  if (shift)
5493  parag->setMovedDown(true);
5494  }
5495  h = ls->y + ls->h;
5496  }
5497  int m = parag->bottomMargin();
5498  if (!parag->next())
5499  m = 0;
5500  else
5501  m = qMax(m, parag->next()->topMargin()) / 2;
5502  h += m;
5503  parag->setHeight(h);
5504  return h - oldHeight;
5505 }

5514 
5515 int Q3TextFormatterBreakInWords::format(Q3TextDocument *doc,Q3TextParagraph *parag,
5516  int start, const QMap<int, QTextLineStart*> &)
5517 {
5518  // make sure bidi information is correct.
5519  (void)parag->string()->isBidi();
5520 
5521  Q3TextStringChar *c = 0;
5522  Q3TextStringChar *firstChar = 0;
5523  int left = doc ? parag->leftMargin() + doc->leftMargin() : 0;
5524  int x = left + (doc ? parag->firstLineMargin() : 0);
5525  int dw = parag->documentVisibleWidth() - (doc ? doc->rightMargin() : 0);
5526  int y = parag->prev() ? qMax(parag->prev()->bottomMargin(),parag->topMargin()) / 2: 0;
5527  int h = y;
5528  int len = parag->length();
5529  if (doc)
5530  x = doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), x, 4);
5531  int rm = parag->rightMargin();
5532  int w = dw - (doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 4) : 0);
5533  bool fullWidth = true;
5534  int minw = 0;
5535  int wused = 0;
5536  bool wrapEnabled = isWrapEnabled(parag);
5537 
5538  start = 0; //######### what is the point with start?! (Matthias)
5539  if (start == 0)
5540  c = &parag->string()->at(0);
5541 
5542  int i = start;
5543  QTextLineStart *lineStart = new QTextLineStart(y, y, 0);
5544  insertLineStart(parag, 0, lineStart);
5545 
5546  QPainter *painter = Q3TextFormat::painter();
5547 
5548  int col = 0;
5549  int ww = 0;
5550  QChar lastChr;
5551  int tabBase = left < x ? left : x;
5552  for (; i < len; ++i, ++col) {
5553  if (c)
5554  lastChr = c->c;
5555  c = &parag->string()->at(i);
5556  // ### the lines below should not be needed
5557  if (painter)
5558  c->format()->setPainter(painter);
5559  if (i > 0) {
5560  c->lineStart = 0;
5561  } else {
5562  c->lineStart = 1;
5563  firstChar = c;
5564  }
5565  if (c->c.unicode() >= 32 || c->isCustom()) {
5566  ww = parag->string()->width(i);
5567  } else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('\t')) {
5568  int nx = parag->nextTab(i, x - tabBase) + tabBase;
5569  if (nx < x)
5570  ww = w - x;
5571  else
5572  ww = nx - x;
5573  } else {
5574  ww = c->format()->width(QLatin1Char(' '));
5575  }
5576 
5577 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
5578  if (c->isCustom() && c->customItem()->ownLine()) {
5579  x = doc ? doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), left, 4) : left;
5580  w = dw - (doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 4) : 0);
5581  c->customItem()->resize(w - x);
5582  w = dw;
5583  y += h;
5584  h = c->height();
5585  lineStart = new QTextLineStart(y, h, h);
5586  insertLineStart(parag, i, lineStart);
5587  c->lineStart = 1;
5588  firstChar = c;
5589  x = 0xffffff;
5590  continue;
5591  }
5592 #endif
5593 
5594  if (wrapEnabled &&
5595  ((wrapAtColumn() == -1 && x + ww > w) ||
5596  (wrapAtColumn() != -1 && col >= wrapAtColumn()))) {
5597  x = doc ? parag->document()->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), left, 4) : left;
5598  w = dw;
5599  y += h;
5600  h = c->height();
5601  lineStart = formatLine(parag, parag->string(), lineStart, firstChar, c-1);
5602  lineStart->y = y;
5603  insertLineStart(parag, i, lineStart);
5604  lineStart->baseLine = c->ascent();
5605  lineStart->h = c->height();
5606  c->lineStart = 1;
5607  firstChar = c;
5608  col = 0;
5609  if (wrapAtColumn() != -1)
5610  minw = qMax(minw, w);
5611  } else if (lineStart) {
5612  lineStart->baseLine = qMax(lineStart->baseLine, c->ascent());
5613  h = qMax(h, c->height());
5614  lineStart->h = h;
5615  }
5616 
5617  c->x = x;
5618  x += ww;
5619  wused = qMax(wused, x);
5620  }
5621 
5622  int m = parag->bottomMargin();
5623  if (!parag->next())
5624  m = 0;
5625  else
5626  m = qMax(m, parag->next()->topMargin()) / 2;
5627  parag->setFullWidth(fullWidth);
5628  y += h + m;
5629  if (doc)
5630  minw += doc->rightMargin();
5631  if (!wrapEnabled)
5632  minw = qMax(minw, wused);
5633 
5634  thisminw = minw;
5635  thiswused = wused;
5636  return y;
5637 }

5652 int Q3TextFormatterBreakWords::format(Q3TextDocument *doc, Q3TextParagraph *parag,

5654 {

5657 
5658  Q3TextStringChar *c = 0;
5659  Q3TextStringChar *firstChar = 0;
5660  Q3TextString *string = parag->string();
5661  int left = doc ? parag->leftMargin() + doc->leftMargin() : 0;
5662  int x = left + (doc ? parag->firstLineMargin() : 0);
5663  int y = parag->prev() ? qMax(parag->prev()->bottomMargin(),parag->topMargin()) / 2: 0;
5664  int h = y;
5665  int len = parag->length();
5666  if (doc)
5667  x = doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), x, 0);
5668  int dw = parag->documentVisibleWidth() - (doc ? (left != x ? 0 : doc->rightMargin()) : 0);
5669

5671  int rm = parag->rightMargin();
5672  int rdiff = doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 0) : 0;
5673  int w = dw - rdiff;
5674  bool fullWidth = true;
5675  int marg = left + rdiff;
5676  int minw = 0;
5677  int wused = 0;
5678  int tminw = marg;
5679  int linespacing = doc ? parag->lineSpacing() : 0;
5680  bool wrapEnabled = isWrapEnabled(parag);
5681 
5682  start = 0;
5683 
5684  int i = start;
5685  QTextLineStart *lineStart = new QTextLineStart(y, y, 0);
5686  insertLineStart(parag, 0, lineStart);
5687  int lastBreak = -1;
5688  int tmpBaseLine = 0, tmph = 0;
5689  bool lastWasNonInlineCustom = false;
5690 
5691  int align = parag->alignment();
5692  if (align == Qt::AlignAuto && doc && doc->alignment() != Qt::AlignAuto)
5693  align = doc->alignment();
5694 
5695  align &= Qt::AlignHorizontal_Mask;
5696 
5697  // ### hack. The last char in the paragraph is always invisible,
5698  // ### and somehow sometimes has a wrong format. It changes
5699  // ### between // layouting and printing. This corrects some
5700  // ### layouting errors in BiDi mode due to this.
5701  if (len > 1) {
5702  c = &parag->string()->at(len - 1);
5703  if (!c->isAnchor()) {
5704  if (c->format())
5705  c->format()->removeRef();
5706  c->setFormat(string->at(len - 2).format());
5707  if (c->format())
5708  c->format()->addRef();
5709  }
5710  }
5711 
5712  c = &parag->string()->at(0);
5713 
5714  QPainter *painter = Q3TextFormat::painter();
5715  int col = 0;
5716  int ww = 0;
5717  QChar lastChr = c->c;
5718  Q3TextFormat *lastFormat = c->format();
5719  int tabBase = left < x ? left : x;
5720  for (; i < len; ++i, ++col) {
5721  if (i) {
5722  c = &parag->string()->at(i-1);
5723  lastChr = c->c;
5724  lastFormat = c->format();
5725  }
5726  bool lastWasOwnLineCustomItem = lastBreak == -2;
5727  bool hadBreakableChar = lastBreak != -1;
5728  bool lastWasHardBreak = lastChr == QChar::LineSeparator;
5729 
5730  // ### next line should not be needed
5731  if (painter)
5732  c->format()->setPainter(painter);
5733  c = &string->at(i);
5734 
5735  if (lastFormat != c->format() && !c->c.isSpace()
5736  && lastFormat->font().italic() && !c->format()->font().italic()) {
5737  int rb = lastFormat->fontMetrics().rightBearing(lastChr);
5738  if (rb < 0)
5739  x -= rb;
5740  }
5741 
5742  if ((i > 0 && (x > curLeft || ww == 0)) || lastWasNonInlineCustom) {
5743  c->lineStart = 0;
5744  } else {
5745  c->lineStart = 1;
5746  firstChar = c;
5747  }
5748 
5749  // ignore non spacing marks for column count.
5750  if (col != 0 && QChar::category(c->c.unicode()) == QChar::Mark_NonSpacing)
5751  --col;
5752 
5753 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
5754  lastWasNonInlineCustom = (c->isCustom() && c->customItem()->placement() != Q3TextCustomItem::PlaceInline);
5755 #endif
5756 
5757  if (c->c.unicode() >= 32 || c->isCustom()) {
5758  ww = string->width(i);
5759  } else if (c->c == QLatin1Char('\t')) {
5760  if (align == Qt::AlignRight || align == Qt::AlignCenter) {
5761  // we can not (yet) do tabs
5762  ww = c->format()->width(QLatin1Char(' '));
5763  } else {
5764  int tabx = lastWasHardBreak ? (left + (doc ? parag->firstLineMargin() : 0)) : x;
5765  int nx = parag->nextTab(i, tabx - tabBase) + tabBase;
5766  if (nx < tabx) // strrrange...
5767  ww = 0;
5768  else
5769  ww = nx - tabx;
5770  }
5771  } else {
5772  ww = c->format()->width(QLatin1Char(' '));
5773  }
5774 
5775 #ifndef QT_NO_TEXTCUSTOMITEM
5776  Q3TextCustomItem* ci = c->customItem();
5777  if (c->isCustom() && ci->ownLine()) {
5778  QTextLineStart *lineStart2 = formatLine(parag, string, lineStart, firstChar, c-1, align, SPACE(w - x - ww));
5779  x = doc ? doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), left, 4) : left;
5780  w = dw - (doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 4) : 0);
5781  ci->resize(w - x);
5782  if (ci->width < w - x) {
5783  if (align & Qt::AlignHCenter)
5784  x = (w - ci->width) / 2;
5785  else if (align & Qt::AlignRight) {
5786  x = w - ci->width;
5787  }
5788  }
5789  c->x = x;
5790  curLeft = x;
5791  if (i == 0 || !isBreakable(string, i-1) ||
5792  string->at(i - 1).lineStart == 0) {
5793  y += qMax(h, qMax(tmph, linespacing));
5794  tmph = c->height();
5795  h = tmph;
5796  lineStart = lineStart2;
5797  lineStart->y = y;
5798  insertLineStart(parag, i, lineStart);
5799  c->lineStart = 1;
5800  firstChar = c;
5801  } else {
5802  tmph = c->height();
5803  h = tmph;
5804  delete lineStart2;
5805  }
5806  lineStart->h = h;
5807  lineStart->baseLine = h;
5808  tmpBaseLine = lineStart->baseLine;
5809  lastBreak = -2;
5810  x = w;
5811  minw = qMax(minw, tminw);
5812 
5813  int tw = ci->minimumWidth() + (doc ? doc->leftMargin() : 0);
5814  if (tw < QWIDGETSIZE_MAX)
5815  tminw = tw;
5816  else
5817  tminw = marg;
5818  wused = qMax(wused, ci->width);
5819  continue;
5820  } else if (c->isCustom() && ci->placement() != Q3TextCustomItem::PlaceInline) {
5821  int tw = ci->minimumWidth();
5822  if (tw < QWIDGETSIZE_MAX)
5823  minw = qMax(minw, tw);
5824  }
5825 #endif
5826  // we break if
5827  // 1. the last character was a hard break (QChar::LineSeparator) or
5828  // 2. the last character was a own-line custom item (eg. table or ruler) or
5829  // 3. wrapping was enabled, it was not a space and following
5830  // condition is true: We either had a breakable character
5831  // previously or we ar allowed to break in words and - either
5832  // we break at w pixels and the current char would exceed that
5833  // or - we break at a column and the current character would
5834  // exceed that.
5835  if (lastWasHardBreak || lastWasOwnLineCustomItem ||
5836  (wrapEnabled &&
5837  ((!c->c.isSpace() && (hadBreakableChar || allowBreakInWords()) &&
5838  ((wrapAtColumn() == -1 && x + ww > w) ||
5839  (wrapAtColumn() != -1 && col >= wrapAtColumn()))))
5840  )
5841  ) {
5842  if (wrapAtColumn() != -1)
5843  minw = qMax(minw, x + ww);
5844  // if a break was forced (no breakable char, hard break or own line custom item), break immediately....
5845  if (!hadBreakableChar || lastWasHardBreak || lastWasOwnLineCustomItem) {
5846  if (lineStart) {
5847  lineStart->baseLine = qMax(lineStart->baseLine, tmpBaseLine);
5848  h = qMax(h, tmph);
5849  lineStart->h = h;
5850  DO_FLOW(lineStart);
5851  }
5852  lineStart = formatLine(parag, string, lineStart, firstChar, c-1, align, SPACE(w - x));
5853  x = doc ? doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), left, 4) : left;
5854  w = dw - (doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 4) : 0);
5855  if (!doc && c->c == QLatin1Char('\t')) { // qt_format_text tab handling
5856  int nx = parag->nextTab(i, x - tabBase) + tabBase;
5857  if (nx < x)
5858  ww = w - x;
5859  else
5860  ww = nx - x;
5861  }
5862  curLeft = x;
5863  y += qMax(h, linespacing);
5864  tmph = c->height();
5865  h = 0;
5866  lineStart->y = y;
5867  insertLineStart(parag, i, lineStart);
5868  lineStart->baseLine = c->ascent();
5869  lineStart->h = c->height();
5870  c->lineStart = 1;
5871  firstChar = c;
5872  tmpBaseLine = lineStart->baseLine;
5873  lastBreak = -1;
5874  col = 0;
5875  if (allowBreakInWords() || lastWasHardBreak) {
5876  minw = qMax(minw, tminw);
5877  tminw = marg + ww;
5878  }
5879  } else { // ... otherwise if we had a breakable char, break there
5880  DO_FLOW(lineStart);
5881  c->x = x;
5882  i = lastBreak;
5883  lineStart = formatLine(parag, string, lineStart, firstChar, parag->at(lastBreak),align, SPACE(w - string->at(i+1).x));
5884  x = doc ? doc->flow()->adjustLMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), left, 4) : left;
5885  w = dw - (doc ? doc->flow()->adjustRMargin(y + parag->rect().y(), parag->rect().height(), rm, 4) : 0);
5886  if (!doc && c->c == QLatin1Char('\t')) { // qt_format_text tab handling
5887  int nx = parag->nextTab(i, x - tabBase) + tabBase;
5888  if (nx < x)
5889  ww = w - x;
5890  else
5891  ww = nx - x;
5892  }
5893  curLeft = x;
5894  y += qMax(h, linespacing);
5895  tmph = c->height();
5896  h = tmph;
5897  lineStart->y = y;
5898  insertLineStart(parag, i + 1, lineStart);
5899  lineStart->baseLine = c->ascent();
5900  lineStart->h = c->height();
5901  c->lineStart = 1;
5902  firstChar = c;
5903  tmpBaseLine = lineStart->baseLine;
5904  lastBreak = -1;
5905  col = 0;
5906  minw = qMax(minw, tminw);
5907  tminw = marg;
5908  continue;
5909  }
5910  } else if (lineStart && isBreakable(string, i)) {
5911  if (len <= 2 || i < len - 1) {
5912  tmpBaseLine = qMax(tmpBaseLine, c->ascent());
5913  tmph = qMax(tmph, c->height());
5914  }
5915  minw = qMax(minw, tminw);
5916 
5917  tminw = marg + ww;
5918  lineStart->baseLine = qMax(lineStart->baseLine, tmpBaseLine);
5919  h = qMax(h, tmph);
5920  lineStart->h = h;
5921  if (i < len - 2 || c->c != QLatin1Char(' '))
5922  lastBreak = i;
5923  } else {
5924  tminw += ww;
5925  int cascent = c->ascent();
5926  int cheight = c->height();
5927  int belowBaseLine = qMax(tmph - tmpBaseLine, cheight-cascent);
5928  tmpBaseLine = qMax(tmpBaseLine, cascent);
5929  tmph = tmpBaseLine + belowBaseLine;
5930  }
5931 
5932  c->x = x;
5933  x += ww;
5934  wused = qMax(wused, x);
5935  }
5936 
5937  if (lineStart) {
5938  lineStart->baseLine = qMax(lineStart->baseLine, tmpBaseLine);
5939  h = qMax(h, tmph);
5940  lineStart->h = h;
5941  // last line in a paragraph is not justified
5942  if (align & Qt::AlignJustify) {
5943  align |= Qt::AlignLeft;
5944  align &= ~(Qt::AlignJustify|Qt::AlignAbsolute);
5945  }
5946  DO_FLOW(lineStart);
5947  lineStart = formatLine(parag, string, lineStart, firstChar, c, align, SPACE(w - x));
5948  delete lineStart;
5949  }
5950 
5951  minw = qMax(minw, tminw);
5952  if (doc)
5953  minw += doc->rightMargin();
5954 
5955  int m = parag->bottomMargin();
5956  if (!parag->next())
5957  m = 0;
5958  else
5959  m = qMax(m, parag->next()->topMargin()) / 2;
5960  parag->setFullWidth(fullWidth);
5961  y += qMax(h, linespacing) + m;
5962 
5963  wused += rm;
5964  if (!wrapEnabled || wrapAtColumn() != -1)
5965  minw = qMax(minw, wused);
5966 
5967  // This is the case where we are breaking wherever we darn well please
5968  // in cases like that, the minw should not be the length of the entire
5969  // word, because we necessarily want to show the word on the whole line.
5970  // example: word wrap in iconview
5971  if (allowBreakInWords() && minw > wused)
5972  minw = wused;
5973 
5974  thisminw = minw;
5975  thiswused = wused;
5976  return y;
5977 }

6026 Q3TextFormat *Q3TextFormatCollection::format(Q3TextFormat *f)
6027 {
6028  if (f->parent() == this || f == defFormat) {
6029  lastFormat = f;
6030  lastFormat->addRef();
6031  return lastFormat;
6032  }
6033 
6034  if (f == lastFormat || (lastFormat && f->key() == lastFormat->key())) {
6035  lastFormat->addRef();
6036  return lastFormat;
6037  }
6038 
6039  Q3TextFormat *fm = cKey.value(f->key());
6040  if (fm) {
6041  lastFormat = fm;
6042  lastFormat->addRef();
6043  return lastFormat;
6044  }
6045 
6046  if (f->key() == defFormat->key())
6047  return defFormat;
6048 
6049  lastFormat = createFormat(*f);

6055 Q3TextFormat *Q3TextFormatCollection::format(Q3TextFormat *of, Q3TextFormat *nf, int flags)
6056 {
6057  if (cres && kof == of->key() && knf == nf->key() && cflags == flags) {
6058  cres->addRef();
6059  return cres;
6060  }
6061 
6062  cres = createFormat(*of);
6063  kof = of->key();
6064  knf = nf->key();
6065  cflags = flags;
6066  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Bold)
6067  cres->fn.setBold(nf->fn.bold());
6068  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Italic)
6069  cres->fn.setItalic(nf->fn.italic());
6070  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Underline)
6071  cres->fn.setUnderline(nf->fn.underline());
6072  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::StrikeOut)
6073  cres->fn.setStrikeOut(nf->fn.strikeOut());
6074  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Family)
6075  cres->fn.setFamily(nf->fn.family());
6076  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Size) {
6077  if (of->usePixelSizes)
6078  cres->fn.setPixelSize(nf->fn.pixelSize());
6079  else
6080  cres->fn.setPointSize(nf->fn.pointSize());
6081  }
6082  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Color)
6083  cres->col = nf->col;
6084  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::Misspelled)
6085  cres->missp = nf->missp;
6086  if (flags & Q3TextFormat::VAlign)
6087  cres->ha = nf->ha;
6088  cres->update();
6089 
6090  Q3TextFormat *fm = cKey.value(cres->key());
6091  if (!fm) {
6092  cres->collection = this;
6093  cKey.insert(cres->key(), cres);
6094  } else {
6095  delete cres;
6096  cres = fm;
6097  cres->addRef();
6098  }
6099 
6100  return cres;
6101 }

6103 Q3TextFormat *Q3TextFormatCollection::format(const QFont &f, const QColor &c)
6104 {
6105  if (cachedFormat && cfont == f && ccol == c) {
6106  cachedFormat->addRef();
6107  return cachedFormat;
6108  }
6109 
6110  QString key = Q3TextFormat::getKey(f, c, false, Q3TextFormat::AlignNormal);
6111  cachedFormat = cKey.value(key);
6112  cfont = f;
6113  ccol = c;
6114 
6115  if (cachedFormat) {
6116  cachedFormat->addRef();
6117  return cachedFormat;
6118  }
6119 
6120  if (key == defFormat->key())
6121  return defFormat;
6122 
6123  cachedFormat = createFormat(f, c);
6124  cachedFormat->collection = this;
6125  cKey.insert(cachedFormat->key(), cachedFormat);
6126  if (cachedFormat->key() != key)
6127  qWarning("ASSERT: keys for format not identical: '%s '%s'", cachedFormat->key().latin1(), key.latin1());
6128  return cachedFormat;
6129 }

6132 {

6143 #define UPDATE(up, lo, rest) \

6147 void Q3TextFormatCollection::updateDefaultFormat(const QFont &font, const QColor &color, Q3StyleSheet *sheet)
6148 {
6149  bool usePixels = font.pointSize() == -1;
6150  bool changeSize = usePixels ? font.pixelSize() != defFormat->fn.pixelSize() :
6151  font.pointSize() != defFormat->fn.pointSize();
6152  int base = usePixels ? font.pixelSize() : font.pointSize();
6153  QHash<QString, Q3TextFormat *>::Iterator it = cKey.begin();
6154  for (; it != cKey.end(); ++it) {
6155  Q3TextFormat *fm = *it;
6156  UPDATE(F, f, amily);
6157  UPDATE(W, w, eight);
6158  UPDATE(B, b, old);
6159  UPDATE(I, i, talic);
6160  UPDATE(U, u, nderline);
6161  if (changeSize) {
6162  fm->stdSize = base;
6163  fm->usePixelSizes = usePixels;
6164  if (usePixels)
6165  fm->fn.setPixelSize(fm->stdSize);
6166  else
6167  fm->fn.setPointSize(fm->stdSize);
6168  sheet->scaleFont(fm->fn, fm->logicalFontSize);
6169  }
6170  if (color.isValid() && color != defFormat->col && fm->col == defFormat->col)
6171  fm->col = color;
6172  fm->update();
6173  }
6174 
6175  defFormat->fn = font;
6176  defFormat->col = color;
6177  defFormat->update();
6178  defFormat->stdSize = base;
6179  defFormat->usePixelSizes = usePixels;
6180 
6181  updateKeys();
6182 }
6183 
6184 // the keys in cKey have changed, rebuild the hashtable
6185 void Q3TextFormatCollection::updateKeys()
6186 {
6187  if (cKey.isEmpty())
6188  return;
6189  Q3TextFormat** formats = new Q3TextFormat *[cKey.count() + 1];
6190  Q3TextFormat **f = formats;
6191  for (QHash<QString, Q3TextFormat *>::Iterator it = cKey.begin(); it != cKey.end(); ++it, ++f)
6192  *f = *it;
6193  *f = 0;
6194  cKey.clear();
6195  for (f = formats; *f; f++)
6196  cKey.insert((*f)->key(), *f);
6197  delete [] formats;
6198 }

6285 QString Q3TextFormat::makeFormatChangeTags(Q3TextFormat* defaultFormat, Q3TextFormat *f,
6286  const QString& oldAnchorHref, const QString& anchorHref ) const
6287 {
6288  QString tag;
6289  if (f)
6290  tag += f->makeFormatEndTags(defaultFormat, oldAnchorHref);
6291 
6292  if (!anchorHref.isEmpty())
6293  tag += QLatin1String("<a href=\"") + anchorHref + QLatin1String("\">");
6294 
6295  if (font() != defaultFormat->font()
6296  || vAlign() != defaultFormat->vAlign()
6297  || color().rgb() != defaultFormat->color().rgb()) {
6298  QString s;
6299  if (font().family() != defaultFormat->font().family())
6300  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("font-family:") + fn.family();
6301  if (font().italic() && font().italic() != defaultFormat->font().italic())
6302  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("font-style:") + (font().italic() ? QLatin1String("italic") : QLatin1String("normal"));
6303  if (font().pointSize() != defaultFormat->font().pointSize())
6304  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("font-size:") + QString::number(fn.pointSize()) + QLatin1String("pt");
6305  if (font().weight() != defaultFormat->font().weight())
6306  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("font-weight:") + QString::number(fn.weight() * 8);
6307  QString textDecoration;
6308  bool none = false;
6309  if ( font().underline() != defaultFormat->font().underline() ) {
6310  if (font().underline())
6311  textDecoration = QLatin1String("underline");
6312  else
6313  none = true;
6314  }
6315  if ( font().overline() != defaultFormat->font().overline() ) {
6316  if (font().overline())
6317  textDecoration += QLatin1String(" overline");
6318  else
6319  none = true;
6320  }
6321  if ( font().strikeOut() != defaultFormat->font().strikeOut() ) {
6322  if (font().strikeOut())
6323  textDecoration += QLatin1String(" line-through");
6324  else
6325  none = true;
6326  }
6327  if (none && textDecoration.isEmpty())
6328  textDecoration = QLatin1String("none");
6329  if (!textDecoration.isEmpty())
6330  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("text-decoration:") + textDecoration;
6331  if (vAlign() != defaultFormat->vAlign()) {
6332  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("vertical-align:");
6333  if (vAlign() == Q3TextFormat::AlignSuperScript)
6334  s += QLatin1String("super");
6335  else if (vAlign() == Q3TextFormat::AlignSubScript)
6336  s += QLatin1String("sub");
6337  else
6338  s += QLatin1String("normal");
6339  }
6340  if (color().rgb() != defaultFormat->color().rgb())
6341  s += QString(s.size()?QLatin1String(";"):QLatin1String("")) + QLatin1String("color:") + col.name();
6342  if (!s.isEmpty())
6343  tag += QLatin1String("<span style=\"") + s + QLatin1String("\">");
6344  }
6345 
6346  return tag;
6347 }
6348 
6349 QString Q3TextFormat::makeFormatEndTags(Q3TextFormat* defaultFormat, const QString& anchorHref) const
6350 {
6351  QString tag;
6352  if (font().family() != defaultFormat->font().family()
6353  || font().pointSize() != defaultFormat->font().pointSize()
6354  || font().weight() != defaultFormat->font().weight()
6355  || font().italic() != defaultFormat->font().italic()
6356  || font().underline() != defaultFormat->font().underline()
6357  || font().strikeOut() != defaultFormat->font().strikeOut()
6358  || vAlign() != defaultFormat->vAlign()
6359  || color().rgb() != defaultFormat->color().rgb())
6360  tag += QLatin1String("</span>");
6361  if (!anchorHref.isEmpty())
6362  tag += QLatin1String("</a>");
6363  return tag;
6364 }

6366 Q3TextFormat Q3TextFormat::makeTextFormat(const Q3StyleSheetItem *style, const QMap<QString,QString>& attr, double scaleFontsFactor) const
6367 {
6368  Q3TextFormat format(*this);
6369  if (!style)
6370  return format;
6371 
6372  if (!style->isAnchor() && style->color().isValid()) {
6373  // the style is not an anchor and defines a color.
6374  // It might be used inside an anchor and it should
6375  // override the link color.
6376  format.linkColor = false;
6377  }
6378  switch (style->verticalAlignment()) {
6379  case Q3StyleSheetItem::VAlignBaseline:
6380  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignNormal);
6381  break;
6382  case Q3StyleSheetItem::VAlignSuper:
6383  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignSuperScript);
6384  break;
6385  case Q3StyleSheetItem::VAlignSub:
6386  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignSubScript);
6387  break;
6388  }
6389 
6390  if (style->fontWeight() != Q3StyleSheetItem::Undefined)
6391  format.fn.setWeight(style->fontWeight());
6392  if (style->fontSize() != Q3StyleSheetItem::Undefined) {
6393  format.fn.setPointSize(style->fontSize());
6394  } else if (style->logicalFontSize() != Q3StyleSheetItem::Undefined) {
6395  format.logicalFontSize = style->logicalFontSize();
6396  if (format.usePixelSizes)
6397  format.fn.setPixelSize(format.stdSize);
6398  else
6399  format.fn.setPointSize(format.stdSize);
6400  style->styleSheet()->scaleFont(format.fn, format.logicalFontSize);
6401  } else if (style->logicalFontSizeStep()) {
6402  format.logicalFontSize += style->logicalFontSizeStep();
6403  if (format.usePixelSizes)
6404  format.fn.setPixelSize(format.stdSize);
6405  else
6406  format.fn.setPointSize(format.stdSize);
6407  style->styleSheet()->scaleFont(format.fn, format.logicalFontSize);
6408  }
6409  if (!style->fontFamily().isEmpty())
6410  format.fn.setFamily(style->fontFamily());
6411  if (style->color().isValid())
6412  format.col = style->color();
6413  if (style->definesFontItalic())
6414  format.fn.setItalic(style->fontItalic());
6415  if (style->definesFontUnderline())
6416  format.fn.setUnderline(style->fontUnderline());
6417  if (style->definesFontStrikeOut())
6418  format.fn.setStrikeOut(style->fontStrikeOut());
6419 
6420  QMap<QString, QString>::ConstIterator it, end = attr.end();
6421 
6422  if (style->name() == QLatin1String("font")) {
6423  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("color"));
6424  if (it != end && ! (*it).isEmpty()){
6425  format.col.setNamedColor(*it);
6426  format.linkColor = false;
6427  }
6428  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("face"));
6429  if (it != end) {
6430  QString family = (*it).section(QLatin1Char(','), 0, 0);
6431  if (family.size())
6432  format.fn.setFamily(family);
6433  }
6434  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("size"));
6435  if (it != end) {
6436  QString a = *it;
6437  int n = a.toInt();
6438  if (a[0] == QLatin1Char('+') || a[0] == QLatin1Char('-'))
6439  n += 3;
6440  format.logicalFontSize = n;
6441  if (format.usePixelSizes)
6442  format.fn.setPixelSize(format.stdSize);
6443  else
6444  format.fn.setPointSize(format.stdSize);
6445  style->styleSheet()->scaleFont(format.fn, format.logicalFontSize);
6446  }
6447  }
6448 
6449  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("style"));
6450  if (it != end) {
6451  QString a = *it;
6452  int count = a.count(QLatin1Char(';'))+1;
6453  for (int s = 0; s < count; s++) {
6454  QString style = a.section(QLatin1Char(';'), s, s);
6455  if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("font-size:")) && style.endsWith(QLatin1String("pt"))) {
6456  format.logicalFontSize = 0;
6457  int size = int(scaleFontsFactor * style.mid(10, style.length() - 12).toDouble());
6458  format.setPointSize(size);
6459  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("font-style:"))) {
6460  QString s = style.mid(11).trimmed();
6461  if (s == QLatin1String("normal"))
6462  format.fn.setItalic(false);
6463  else if (s == QLatin1String("italic") || s == QLatin1String("oblique"))
6464  format.fn.setItalic(true);
6465  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("font-weight:"))) {
6466  QString s = style.mid(12);
6467  bool ok = true;
6468  int n = s.toInt(&ok);
6469  if (ok)
6470  format.fn.setWeight(n/8);
6471  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("font-family:"))) {
6472  QString family = style.mid(12).section(QLatin1Char(','),0,0);
6473  family.replace(QLatin1Char('\"'), QLatin1Char(' '));
6474  family.replace(QLatin1Char('\''), QLatin1Char(' '));
6475  family = family.trimmed();
6476  format.fn.setFamily(family);
6477  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("text-decoration:"))) {
6478  QString s = style.mid( 16 );
6479  format.fn.setOverline(s.contains(QLatin1String("overline")));
6480  format.fn.setStrikeOut(s.contains(QLatin1String("line-through")));
6481  format.fn.setUnderline(s.contains(QLatin1String("underline")));
6482  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("vertical-align:"))) {
6483  QString s = style.mid(15).trimmed();
6484  if (s == QLatin1String("sub"))
6485  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignSubScript);
6486  else if (s == QLatin1String("super"))
6487  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignSuperScript);
6488  else
6489  format.setVAlign(Q3TextFormat::AlignNormal);
6490  } else if (style.startsWith(QLatin1String("color:"))) {
6491  format.col.setNamedColor(style.mid(6));
6492  format.linkColor = false;
6493  }
6494  }
6495  }
6496 
6497  format.update();
6498  return format;
6499 }

6513 Q3TextImage::Q3TextImage(Q3TextDocument *p, const QMap<QString, QString> &attr, const QString& context,
6514  Q3MimeSourceFactory &factory)
6515  : Q3TextCustomItem(p)
6516 {
6517  width = height = 0;
6518 
6519  QMap<QString, QString>::ConstIterator it, end = attr.end();
6520  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("width"));
6521  if (it != end)
6522  width = (*it).toInt();
6523  it = attr.find(QLatin1String("height"));
6524  if (it != end)
6525  height = (*it).toInt();
6526 
6527  reg = 0;
6528  QString imageName = attr[QLatin1String("src")];
6529 
6530  if (imageName.size() == 0)
6531  imageName = attr[QLatin1String("source")];
6532 
6533  if (!imageName.isEmpty()) {
6534  imgId = QString(QLatin1String("%1,%2,%3,%4")).arg(imageName).arg(width).arg(height).arg((ulong)&factory);
6535  if (!pixmap_map)
6536  pixmap_map = new QMap<QString, QPixmapInt>;
6537  if (pixmap_map->contains(imgId)) {
6538  QPixmapInt& pmi = pixmap_map->operator[](imgId);
6539  pm = pmi.pm;
6540  pmi.ref++;
6541  width = pm.width();
6542  height = pm.height();
6543  } else {
6544  QImage img;
6545  const QMimeSource* m =
6546  factory.data(imageName, context);
6547  if (!m) {
6548  qCritical("Q3TextImage: no mimesource for %s", imageName.latin1());
6549  }
6550  else {
6551  if (!Q3ImageDrag::decode(m, img)) {
6552  qCritical("Q3TextImage: cannot decode %s", imageName.latin1());
6553  }
6554  }
6555 
6556  if (!img.isNull()) {
6557  if (width == 0) {
6558  width = img.width();
6559  if (height != 0) {
6560  width = img.width() * height / img.height();
6561  }
6562  }
6563  if (height == 0) {
6564  height = img.height();
6565  if (width != img.width()) {
6566  height = img.height() * width / img.width();
6567  }
6568  }
6569  if (img.width() != width || img.height() != height){
6570 #ifndef QT_NO_IMAGE_SMOOTHSCALE
6571  img = img.smoothScale(width, height);
6572 #endif
6573  width = img.width();
6574  height = img.height();
6575  }
6576  pm.convertFromImage(img);
6577  }
6578  if (!pm.isNull()) {
6579  QPixmapInt& pmi = pixmap_map->operator[](imgId);
6580  pmi.pm = pm;
6581  pmi.ref++;
6582  }
6583  }
6584  if (pm.hasAlphaChannel()) {
6585  QRegion mask(pm.mask());
6586  QRegion all(0, 0, pm.width(), pm.height());
6587  reg = new QRegion(all.subtracted(mask));
6588  }
6589  }
6590 
6591  if (pm.isNull() && (width*height)==0)
6592  width = height = 50;
6593 
6594  place = PlaceInline;
6595  if (attr[QLatin1String("align")] == QLatin1String("left"))
6596  place = PlaceLeft;
6597  else if (attr[QLatin1String("align")] == QLatin1String("right"))
6598  place = PlaceRight;
6599 
6600  tmpwidth = width;
6601  tmpheight = height;
6602 
6603  attributes = attr;
6604 }
